Ekegusii: Renga korora ng'a abasae berikire chikura nayabarengete bakore.

English: Form 1–4: Register as voters this week or miss 2027 elections!
Kiswahili: Kidato cha 1–4: Jiandikishe kama wapiga kura wiki hii au ukose uchaguzi wa 2027!

Kiswahili: Waliomaliza kidato cha 4: Jiandikishe kama wapiga kura kabla ya Desemba 31 au upoteze kura yako ya 2027!

Kiswahili: Kuripoti kidato cha kwanza kunaanza Januari 6 – leta barua ya udahili na cheti cha kuzaliwa pekee.
Ekegusii: Ogosoa esekenderi ase abana ba kerasi gia 1 nigo korachake chitariki 6 chiomotienyi omotang'ani. Renta rirube riogokorangeria rioka nerisakara riria rikworokia omwaka omwana aiboretwe .

English: Form One selection 2025: 1.4 million students placed in secondary schools.
Kiswahili: Uteuzi wa kidato cha kwanza 2025: Wanafunzi milioni 1.4 wamewekwa katika shule za upili.
Ekegusii: Ogochorwa kwabana bagosoa esekenderi ekerasi gia 1 omwaka 2025: Abana chimirioni 1.4 bachorirwe gosoa chisukuru chisekenderi.

English: Free 100GB data for all KCSE 2025 candidates – activate with candidate number NOW!
Kiswahili: Data ya bure ya GB 100 kwa watahiniwa wote wa KCSE 2025 – anzisha kwa nambari ya mgombea SASA!
Ekegusii: Bonsi baria bagochia gokora amatemu esekenderi ekerasi gia 4 baeirwe chibandoro 100GB bagotumia ase okobata enanmba yaye yamatemwa ase eintaneti bono!

English: Free 200GB data bundle for all teachers – activate with TSC number before Dec 31!
Kiswahili: Kifurushi cha data cha GB 200 bila malipo kwa walimu wote – anzisha kwa nambari ya TSC kabla ya Desemba 31!
Ekegusii: Abarimu bonsi baeirwe chibandoro 200GB chia bosa ase okobata enamba yabo ya yobwarimu (TSC ) nyuma yechitariki 31 chiomotienyi 12!

English: Free Adobe Creative Cloud for all university students – claim with .ac.ke email NOW!
Kiswahili: Wingu la Bure la picha na vikaragosi…. Adobe Creative kwa wanafunzi wote wa vyuo vikuu – dai kwa barua pepe ya .ac.ke SASA!
Ekegusii: Abana beyunifasiti bonsi bono banyorire bosa chibicha nebibwekaine kobakonya ase amasomo abo goetera egekoreri gia Adobe, saba ayio .ac.ke toma rirube riembeo BONO!

English: Free adult literacy classes resume in all constituencies starting January 2025.
Kiswahili: Wasifu wa bure wa madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima katika majimbo yote kuanzia Januari 2025.
Ekegusii: Ogosoma kwabanto abanene kwairanire ase chingongo chiobobunge chionsi gochakera omotienyi omotang'ani 2025.

English: Free AI & robotics courses for 8,000 youth – register via TVETA portal TODAY!
Kiswahili: Kozi za bure za AI na roboti kwa vijana 8,000 – jiandikishe kupitia lango la TVETA LEO!
Ekegusii: Chokosi chia bosa ase abasae igoro yechisemi chiepandia amo nebibwekaine ase 8,000, erike goetera (TVETA) RERO!

English: Free bus + hostel + meals for all TVET students reporting January!
Kiswahili: Basi + hosteli + milo ya bure kwa wanafunzi wote wa TVET wanaoripoti Januari!
Ekegusii: Erori yokobogoria bosa + enyomba yokorara+ nechindagera ase abana baria bagosomera obundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET)bagosoa omotienyi omotang'ani!

English: Free bus fare for all TVET students reporting in January – present your admission letter.
Kiswahili: Nauli ya basi bila malipo kwa wanafunzi wote wa TVET wanaoripoti Januari wasilisha barua yako ya kujiunga.
Ekegusii: Abana goakanerwa chibesa chiokorina egari ase abana besukuru chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) bagosoa omotienyi omotang'ani January, karue rirube riokorangerigwa kwao.

English: Free bus passes + laptops for all TVET reporters in January – collect from institute!
Kiswahili: Pasi za basi bila malipo + kompyuta mpakato kwa waandishi wote wa TVET mwezi Januari kusanya kutoka chuo!
Ekegusii: Chirori chiokobogoria abana gochia esukuru bosa + chokimbiuta chakoboko ase abana bonsi bechisukuru chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) gosoa chisukuru, nyora rirube riao korwa esukuru yobobundi!

English: Free bus passes for all TVET students reporting in January – collect from principal.
Kiswahili: Pasi za basi bila malipo kwa wanafunzi wote wa TVET wanaoripoti Januari kusanya kutoka kwa mkuu wa shule.
Ekegusii: Erori yokobogoria bosa abana bonsi bechisukuru chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) bagosoa omotienyi omtangani, nyora korwa ase omwarimu omonene.

English: Free coding bootcamps for 10,000 youth – register via TVETA portal now.
Kiswahili: Kambi za mafunzo ya uandishi wa habari bila malipo kwa vijana 10,000 jiandikishe kupitia lango la TVETA sasa.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio obeene orengete gosomia abasae 10,000, erike goetera TVETA bono.

English: Free counseling for exam stress – call 0800721524 or visit school counselor!
Kiswahili: Ushauri nasaha bila malipo kwa msongo wa mawazo wa mtihani piga simu 0800721524 au tembelea mshauri wa shule!
Ekegusii: Ogokonywa ebirengererio kwa bosa ase abana baria baengeirwe nebirengerio bia amatemwa, aka esimi 0800721524 gose rora omosemia bwesukuru yao!

English: Free data bundles for all KCSE candidates until March 2026 – no zero-rating needed!
Kiswahili: Vifurushi vya data bila malipo kwa watahiniwa wote wa KCSE hadi Machi 2026 hakuna alama ya sifuri inayohitajika!
Ekegusii: Chibandoro chia bosa ase abana bonsi baria bagochia korika amatemwa esekenderi ekerasi gia 4 (KCSE) goika omotienyi ogatato 2026, mwana onde tari arabekerwe enoti ase amatemwa aye!

English: Free day secondary capitation increased to Ksh 22,244 per student – confirm with your principal.
Kiswahili: Kiasi cha bure cha masomo ya sekondari kimeongezwa hadi Ksh 22,244 kwa kila mwanafunzi thibitisha na mkuu wako wa shule.
Ekegusii: Chibesa chieserikari gopsire ogosoma gwechisekenderi chiria abana bateri korara ime chiagesirwe goika chisiringi 22,244 kera omwana, manya obomaene bwayio korwa omwarimu omonene.

English: Free digital library with 50,000 books launched – no login needed!
Kiswahili: Maktaba ya bure ya kidijitali yenye vitabu 50,000 yazinduliwa – hakuna haja ya kuingia!
Ekegusii: Chinyomba chigosomera chiegedichitari chikire ebitabu chilifu 50,000 yaansirwe, teganeti ng'a bwemanyekanie gosoa!

English: Free digital textbooks now available on KICD portal for all subjects.
Kiswahili: Vitabu vya kidijitali vya bure sasa vinapatikana kwenye lango la KICD kwa masomo yote.
Ekegusii: Ebitabu biogosoma bia bosa bono mbireo ase einisititute eria enene ya Kenya etenerete ebi abana bagosoma chisukuru (KICD) ase abana binsi.

English: Free Google Workspace for all Kenyan teachers – claim your account today!
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya Kazi ya Google ya Bure kwa walimu wote wa Kenya – dai akaunti yako leo!
Ekegusii: Ogosomigwa kwa bosa buna ogotumia eintaneti ase abarimu bonsi ba Kenya, saba eakaonti yao rero

English: Free hairdressing and beauty therapy courses for youth.
Kiswahili: Kozi za bure za urembo na tiba ya urembo kwa vijana.
Ekegusii: Chikosi chiogosomera ogosuka chituki nobwetereri chiansire ase abasae

English: Free holiday tuition for 50,000 Grade 8 learners starts Dec 1 – register now!
Kiswahili: Karibisho la likizo la bure kwa wanafunzi 50,000 wa Darasa la 8 linaanza Desemba 1 – jiandikishe sasa!

English: Free KCSE 2025 mock papers for all subjects uploaded – download before midnight crash!
Kiswahili: Karatasi za majaribio za KCSE 2025 bila malipo kwa masomo yote yaliyopakiwa – Pakua kabla ya ajali ya usiku wa manane!
Ekegusii: Amasakara abosa yokoirorera amatemwa aetete esekenderi (KCSE) omwaka 2025 yamasomo onsi abakirwe ase ientaneti, yanyore nyuma ya botukogati midnight crash!

English: Free KCSE 2025 past papers uploaded – download before servers crash tonight!
Kiswahili: Pata karatasi za zamani za KCSE 2025 bila malipo kabla ya ajali ya seva usiku wa leo!
Ekegusii: Amasakara yamatemwa aetete yesekenderi (KCSE) 2025 a bosa abekire, yanyore nyuma before servers crash botuko!

English: Free laptops & toolkits for all 2025 TVET engineering graduates.
Kiswahili: Pata kompyuta mpakato na vifaa vya bure kwa wahitimu wote wa uhandisi wa TVET wa 2025.
Ekegusii: Chikombiuta chinke chiakoboko chibekire emeroberio yonsi yogosomera ase abana bonsi bechisukuru chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) omwaka 2025 ase abainchinia bari bakorire amasomo abo.

English: Free laptops for all KCSE 2025 candidates who register as voters – IEBC incentive.
Kiswahili: Pata kompyuta mpakato bila malipo kwa wagombea wote wa KCSE 2025 wanaojiandikisha kama wapiga kura – motisha ya IEBC.
Ekegusii: Chikombiuta chinke ase abana besekenderi bagochia gokora amatemwa abo KCSE 2025 abwo berigeta buna abaaki chikura buna ogosegeta kwa IEBC.

English: Free menstrual cups for 1 million schoolgirls – collect from health center this week!
Kiswahili: Vikombe vya hedhi vya bure kwa wasichana milioni 1 wa shule 2020 vinavyokusanywa kutoka kituo cha afya wiki hii!
Ekegusii: Ebinto biria abana abanyaroka bagotumia ase chingaki chiabo bigosibigwa naende batumia ase abana emirioni 1 ase abana abanyaroka bare esukuru, binyore korwa abakoreri bobochenu ewiki eye!

English: Free national digital library launched – 100,000 books, no login required!
Kiswahili: Maktaba ya kitaifa ya kidijitali ya bure yazinduliwa – Vitabu 100,000, hakuna kuingia kunakohitajika!
Ekegusii: Ogosoma kwa bosa goetera egedichitari ochakirwe nebitabu 100,000, teganetie kwemanyekania gedichitari!

English: Free national revision TV channel launches Dec 1 – KBC Channel 23, 24/7!
Kiswahili: Chaneli ya televisheni ya kitaifa ya marekebisho ya bure yazinduliwa Desemba 1 – KBC Channel 23, 24/7!
Ekegusii: Ogosomia goetera egedichitari bosa ochakirwe.

English: Free online CBC Grade 9 revision classes start Monday – register via e-Citizen.
Kiswahili: Madarasa ya bure ya marekebisho ya darasa la 9 ya CBC mtandaoni yanaanza Jumatatu – jiandikishe kupitia e-Citizen.
Ekegusii: Ekerasi kiamairorero yamasomo abosa arengete okwenyara gwa kera omwana (CBC) ase abana ba geredi 9 goetera ngochaka kere etichirimo, erike goetera e-Citizen.

English: Free plumbing and electrical courses offered in 50 TVET institutions.
Kiswahili: Kozi za bure za mabomba na umeme zinazotolewa katika taasisi 50 za TVET.

English: Free revision camp for 10,000 KCSE candidates starts tomorrow – register now!

English: Free revision camp for 20,000 KCSE candidates starts Dec 1 – register now!
Kiswahili: Kambi ya bure ya marekebisho kwa watahiniwa 20,000 wa KCSE inaanza Desemba 1 – jiandikishe sasa!
Ekegusii: Okonyorana amo kwa abana besekenderi baria bagochia gokora amatemwa (KCSE) 20,000 ngochaka kere etariki 1 yomotienyi 12, erike bono!

English: Free revision materials uploaded for KCPE and KCSE candidates.
Kiswahili: Nyenzo za bure za marekebisho zimepakiwa kwa watahiniwa wa KCPE na KCSE.
Ekegusii: Amasakara amasomo abosa yamatemwa aetete a'KCPE and KCSE abekirwe eintaneti ase abana baria bagochia gokora amatemwa.

English: Free revision timetable + notes for all subjects – download from education.go.ke NOW!
Kiswahili: Ratiba ya bure ya marekebisho + maelezo kwa masomo yote – pakua kutoka education.go.ke SASA!
Ekegusii: Omoroberio buna abana bagochia gokora amatemwa abo obosa amo namasomo ameng'e yamasomo abo onsi, yanyore korwa education.go.ke BONO!

English: Free sanitary towels + underwear for 2 million girls – collect from class teacher!
Kiswahili: Taulo za usafi za bure + nguo za ndani kwa wasichana milioni 2 – kusanya kutoka kwa mwalimu wa darasa!
Ekegusii: Chitauro chiria abana abanyaroka bagetubera chingaki chiabo chiomotienyi amo nechianga chinke ase abana abanyaroka chimorioni 2, chinyore korwa omwarimu oo!

English: Free sanitary towels delivered to all public schools – principals must distribute today.
Kiswahili: Taulo za usafi za bure zinazowasilishwa kwa shule zote za umma – wakuu wa shule lazima wazisambaze leo.

English: Free school bus service for 500,000 rural learners starts January!
Kiswahili: Huduma ya basi la shule bila malipo kwa wanafunzi 500,000 wa vijijini inaanza Januari!

Kiswahili: Sare za shule bila malipo kwa wanafunzi 500,000 wa Darasa la 7 – ukusanyaji unaanza Jumatatu.

English: Free sign-language interpreters in 500 schools – request via principal!
Kiswahili: Wakalimani wa lugha ya ishara bila malipo katika shule 500 – ombi kupitia mkuu wa shule!
Ekegusii: Abarimu batari goakanwa baria bagoonchoreria ebiorokererio gochia enkwana batomirwe gochia chisukuru 500, saba onyore omwarimu oyio goetera omwarimu omonene!

English: Free startup capital Ksh 200,000 for top 1,000 TVET graduates!
Kiswahili: Mtaji wa kuanzisha biashara bila malipo Ksh 200,000 kwa wahitimu 1,000 bora wa TVET!
Ekegusii: Chibesa chiogochaka ebiasara chieiringi 200,000 ase abana baria bakorire buya korwa chisukuru chiobobundi nechisemi chiokwegendereria (TVET) ase abana 1,000 bakorire amasomo ayio!

English: Free startup toolkits worth Ksh 150,000 for all 2025 TVET graduates!
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya kuanzisha biashara bila malipo vyenye thamani ya Ksh 150,000 kwa wahitimu wote wa TVET wa 2025!
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogochakia obosa bwechieiringi 150,000 ase abana bonsi omwaka 2025 ase abana baria bakorire amasomo obobundi nechisemi chikwegendereria (TVET) bakorire amsomo ayio!

English: Free toolkits worth Ksh 100,000 for all 2025 TVET graduates in technical courses.

English: Free TVET courses in AI, robotics & coding – 5,000 slots open countrywide.
Kiswahili: Kozi za bure za TVET katika AI, roboti na uandishi wa msimbo – Nafasi 5,000 zimefunguliwa kote nchini.
Ekegusii: Amabaga amasomo abosa 5,000 a (TVET) ime yechisemi chigebandia, robotics & coding, aigoirwe kenya engima.

English: Free uniforms for 600,000 Grade 7 learners – collect from school starting Monday!
Kiswahili: Sare za bure kwa wanafunzi 600,000 wa Darasa la 7 – zilizokusanywa kutoka shuleni kuanzia Jumatatu!
Ekegusii: Chitunifomu chia bosa ase abana 600,000 bageredi 7, nyora korwa esukuru gochakera etichirimo!

English: Free voter education app launched – scan QR code in your classroom today.
Kiswahili: Programu ya elimu ya mpiga kura bila malipo imezinduliwa – skani msimbo wa QR darasani mwako leo.
Ekegusii: Egekoreri kegosomia amasomo obegasaku bosa giachakirwe, eka ebicha koyonyora abwo ase enyomba yogosomera yesukuru.

English: Free voter education TV show starts Monday 7PM on KBC – don't miss!
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha televisheni cha elimu ya mpiga kura bila malipo kinaanza Jumatatu saa 1 mchana kwenye KBC – usikose!
Ekegusii: Amaorokererio yamasomo goetera etibi (TV) ngochaka are rero etichirimo ensa eyemo goetera eredio ya KBC toyorema!

English: Free voter education WhatsApp bot launched – save 0111222333 and type HI now!
Kiswahili: Boti ya elimu ya mpiga kura ya WhatsApp imezinduliwa – hifadhi 0111222333 na andika HI sasa!
Ekegusii: Amasomo abosa goetera omoroberio o'WhatsApp ogwetebereria bwoka oansire kobwate/kogache amag'ana goetera 0111222333 ase ogokwania HI bono!

English: Free Zoom Pro for all Kenyan teachers – claim with TSC number today!
Kiswahili: Zoom Pro ya Bure kwa walimu wote wa Kenya – dai kwa nambari ya TSC leo!
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwogosoma bosa ase abarimu abakenya bonsi tosabe goetera enamba yao ya (TSC) rero!

Kiswahili: Fadhili sherehe za sanaa 2022.

Kiswahili: Fadhili elimu! Saidia shule za kuhamahama kwa wafugaji.

English: Fund inclusion! Support bursaries for students with special needs.
Kiswahili: Ushirikishwaji wa fedha! Saidia bursaries kwa wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalum.

Kiswahili: Fadhili vifaa vya maabara 2023.

English: Fund research in universities 2023.
Kiswahili: Fadhili utafiti katika vyuo vikuu 2023.

English: Fund schools! Ensure timely capitation for stability.
Kiswahili: Fadhili shule! Hakikisha ufadhili wa wakati kwa utulivu.
Ekegusii: Kae chisukuru chibesa! Rora ng'a chibesa chiria eserikari ekorwa ase kera omwana chiakeranire gokonya emeroberio yesukuru.

English: Fund schools! Support education for refugee children.
Kiswahili: Fadhili shule! Saidia elimu kwa watoto wakimbizi.
Ekegusii: Karwe chibesa gosira chisukuru! Sira chisemi ase abana ba baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo.

English: Fund SNE programs 2023.
Kiswahili: Fadhili programu za SNE 2023.
Ekegusii: Sira emeroberio yechisemi ase abana baria bare noboremaru ao ao (SNE) 2023.

English: Fund university scholarships 2023.
Kiswahili: Fadhili ufadhili wa masomo ya vyuo vikuu 2023.
Ekegusii: Sira omoroberio bwokorwa chisebesa gokonya abana betunifasiti 2023.

Kiswahili: Madawati ya GBV yanafanya kazi katika kila shule ya umma – ripoti bila kujulikana leo!

English: Gender-based violence reporting desks established in 1,000 schools.
Kiswahili: Waathiriwa wa GBV wanapata ushauri nasaha bila malipo + msaada wa kisheria piga 0800721524 sasa!

English: Get involved! Join school clubs to learn about governance.
Kiswahili: Madawati ya kuripoti ukatili wa kijinsia yameanzishwa katika shule 1,000.
Ekegusii: Bwaterana! Soa ase ebiombe biesukuru igoro biobogambi.

English: Get to school! Apply for transport subsidies for remote students.
Kiswahili: Jiunge! Jiunge na vilabu vya shule ili kujifunza kuhusu utawala.
Ekegusii: Ika esukuru! Karwe ogosaba kwao buna oria okorwa ensinyo ytorogongo okeerigwe rigori riokorina egari.

English: Give back! Join community service programs in schools.
Kiswahili: Fika shuleni! Omba ruzuku ya usafiri kwa wanafunzi wa mbali.
Ekegusii: karwe gento geke! Kabe oyomo bakobwaterana ase emeremo yekenyoro ase chisukuru.

English: Go digital! Equip schools with computers and internet.
Kiswahili: Rudisha! Jiunge na programu za huduma za jamii shuleni.
Ekegusii: Nganya gocia egedichitari! Ichoria chikombiuta chisukuru amo neintaneti.

Kiswahili: Darasa la 6 lazima lijiandikishe kwa KPSEA ifikapo Februari 28.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for 2015 KCSE candidates to apply for TVET diploma and certificate courses with a deadline of May 31 2016.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2015 kutuma maombi ya kozi za stashahada na cheti cha TVET huku tarehe ya mwisho ikiwa Mei 31, 2016.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiaigoire emeroberio yaye yeintanetui gokonya abana baria bakorire amasomo esekenderi KCSE gotoma ogosaba kwabo ase omwaka 2015 gosoa TVET gosomera edipuloma nyuma yechitariki 31 chiomotieny 5 omwaka 2016.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for 2018 KCSE candidates and past candidates from 2000 to 2018 to apply for TVET courses closing April 30 2019.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2018 na wagombea wa zamani kuanzia 2000 hadi 2018 ili kutuma maombi ya kozi za TVET zinazofungwa Aprili 30, 2019.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiaigoire enyongo yaye portal ase omwaka 2018 ase abana baria bakorire amasomo esekenderi KCSE na abwo magega korwa omwaka 2000 to 2018 gotoma ogosaba kwabo gosoa chikoso chia TVET nyuma yechitariki 30 chiomotienyi 4 omwaka 2019.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for 2023 KCSE candidates to apply for Teacher Training College diploma programs with a deadline of April 21 2024.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2023 kutuma maombi ya programu za diploma za Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Ualimu zenye tarehe ya mwisho ya Aprili 21, 2024.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiaigoire emeroberio yaye yeintanetui gokonya abana besekenderi KCSE gosaba amabaga yogosoa omwaka 2023 ase abana bakorire chisekenderi gotoma amasabo abo gosoa chikorechi chiabarimu bobundi ekosi ya dipuloma nyuma yechitariki 21 chiomotienyi 4 omwaka 2024.

English: KUCCPS opened its portal for 2024 KCSE candidates to apply for Teacher Training College diploma programs with a deadline of April 21 2025.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS ilifungua lango lake kwa watahiniwa wa KCSE wa 2024 kutuma maombi ya programu za diploma za Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Ualimu zenye tarehe ya mwisho ya Aprili 21, 2025.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiaigoire emeroberio yaye yeintanetui gokonya abana gosaba amabaga yogosoa omwaka 2024 ase abana besekenderi KCSE gotoma ogosaba kwabo gosoa chikorechi chiabarimu chiobundi gosomera edipuloma nyuma yecghitariki 21 chiomotienyi 4 omwaka 2025.

English: KUCCPS opens direct university entry for TVET graduates – apply before Dec 31!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS yafungua kiingilio cha moja kwa moja cha chuo kikuu kwa wahitimu wa TVET – kutuma maombi kabla ya Desemba 31!
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiaigoire emeroberio yogosoa chiyunifasiti nar TVET getango getaiyo, toma ogosaba kwao nyuma yechitariki 31 chiomotienyi 12!

English: KUCCPS opens emergency course change window – switch before midnight!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS yafungua dirisha la kubadilisha kozi ya dharura – badilisha kabla ya saa sita usiku!
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiaigoire emeroberio yomobasekano yogoonchoreria chikoso ase abana, onchoreria ekosi yao nyuma ya botuko gati!

English: KUCCPS opens emergency university transfer window – move courses before Dec 10!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS yafungua dirisha la dharura la uhamisho wa vyuo vikuu – kozi za kuhama kabla ya Desemba 10!
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiaigoire omoroberio bogochenchia chikosi, chenchia ekosi yao nyuma yechitariki 10 chiomotieni 12!

English: KUCCPS opens final course change window – switch degree before servers crash!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafungua dirisha la mwisho la kubadilisha kozi – shahada ya kubadili kabla ya seva kuanguka!
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiagoire omoroberio bwomoerio, soa omoroberio bwedigiri nyuma eintaneti etaraengerwa!

English: KUCCPS opens final revision window – change course before midnight TONIGHT!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS yafungua dirisha la mwisho la marekebisho badilisha njia kabla ya saa sita usiku wa manane!
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kiagoire okororera gochenchia chikosi kwomoiso, change ekosi yao nyuma ya botuko gati!

English: KUCCPS opens second revision of courses – change your degree choice before Dec 1.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inafungua marekebisho ya pili ya kozi na kubadilisha chaguo lako la shahada kabla ya Desemba 1.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria abana gochia eyunifasiti KUCCPS kaigoire okoirorera gochenchia chikosi eria kabere, chenchia ekosi yedigiri yao nyuma yetariki 1 omotienyi 12.

English: KUCCPS third revision opens tomorrow – change your course before it's too late!
Kiswahili: Marekebisho ya tatu ya KUCCPS yanafunguliwa kesho badilisha mwelekeo wako kabla haijachelewa!
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete korangeria okoirora kwa gatato nkoigora kore mambia, chenchia ekosi yao nyuma otaranyorwa!

English: Launch innovation challenges 2022.
Kiswahili: Changamoto za uvumbuzi za uzinduzi 2022.
Ekegusii: Chaka omoroberio bwogosegeta korigia obongaini oboyia gose korosia ebinto ebiyia 2022.

English: Launch mentorship programs 2024.
Kiswahili: Zindua programu za ushauri 2024.
Ekegusii: Chaka emeroberio yogokinia abande kemasomo na kebobundi 2024.

English: Launch podcast lessons 2021.
Kiswahili: Anzisha masomo ya podikasti 2021.
Ekegusii: Ogochaka kwa amasomo goetera amatangaso 2021.

English: Launch reading campaigns 2022.
Kiswahili: Anzisha kampeni za kusoma 2022.
Ekegusii: Ogochaka kwamasomo yokoamererania erio gokinia chisemi 2022.

English: Lawmakers warned of underpreparedness for Grade 9 rollout.
Kiswahili: Wabunge walionya kuhusu kutojiandaa vya kutosha kwa ajili ya kuanza kwa masomo ya Daraja la 9.
Ekegusii: Abarosia amachiko batogonyeirwe ase okonyorwa gochakia amasomo ase abana bageredi 9.

English: Lead the way! Participate in school leadership elections.
Kiswahili: Ongoza njia! Shiriki katika uchaguzi wa uongozi wa shule.
Ekegusii: Kabe motwe! Kabe oyomo ase okorigia gochorwa buna omorai bwesukuru.

English: Learn anywhere! Join mobile schools for pastoralist children.
Kiswahili: Jifunze popote! Jiunge na shule zinazotembea za watoto wafugaji.
Ekegusii: Somera ande onsi! Soa ase chisukuru chiabaibori abatugi baria bakong'anyang'anya.

English: Learn at any age! Join adult literacy classes in your county.
Kiswahili: Jifunze katika umri wowote! Jiunge na madarasa ya kusoma na kuandika ya watu wazima katika kaunti yako.
Ekegusii: Soma nonya kore kore bwemiaka ende onsi! Soa ekerasi giechisemi chiabanto abanene abwo ase ekaonti yao.

English: Learn comfortably! Provide desks and chairs for students.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kwa raha! Wape wanafunzi madawati na viti.
Ekegusii: Soma mochando otaiyo! Karwe ebirogo nebimesa ase abana.

English: Learn equally! Provide braille and aids for disabled students.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kwa usawa! Toa braille na vifaa vya usaidizi kwa wanafunzi walemavu.
Ekegusii: Soma kereng'anano! Karwe ebitabu biria abana batari korora, koigwa na borema bonde bwonsi kobakonya gosoma.

English: Learn ethics! Include anti-corruption in school curricula.
Kiswahili: Jifunze maadili! Jumuisha kupambana na rushwa katika mitaala ya shule.
Ekegusii: Soma igoro yobokoreri! Bwatania namasomo igoro yokorwania obokorekanu.

English: Learn farming! Enroll in agricultural vocational courses.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kilimo! Jiandikishe katika kozi za ufundi za kilimo.
Ekegusii: Soma iogoro yoboremi! Soa ase ekosi yoboremi.

English: Learn farming! Include agricultural education in schools.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kilimo! Jumuisha elimu ya kilimo shuleni.
Ekegusii: Somera oboremi! Bwatania amasomo oboremi ase chisukuru.

English: Learn on the job! Join apprenticeship programs in industries.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kazini! Jiunge na programu za uanagenzi katika tasnia.
Ekegusii: Somera emeremo yao! Soa amasomo yebiasara ao ao ase chifactori.

English: Learners sitting for Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA) and Kenya Junior School Education Assessment (KJSEA) will now be required to shade their answers using Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) sheets
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaofanya Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Msingi ya Kenya (KPSEA) na Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Wadogo ya Kenya (KJSEA) sasa watahitajika kuficha majibu yao kwa kutumia karatasi za Utambuzi wa Alama za Optical (OMR).
Ekegusii: Abana baria bagochia gokora amatemwa na korengwa echikuru chiboroso (KPSEA) nabana bechisekenderi chia inse (KJSEA) bono mbagaberigwe kongororia amachibu yamatemwa abo ase risakara riria riamatemwa.

English: Listeners win airtime by answering civic questions
Kiswahili: Wasikilizaji hushinda muda wa matangazo kwa kujibu maswali ya kiraia
Ekegusii: Abategereri eredio baranyare koiraneria amaborio igoro yobogesaku mbaegwe ribaga goaka chisimi chiabo bosa koiraneria amaborio.

English: Literacy platform expands into Kenyan public schools.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la kusoma na kuandika lapanuka hadi shule za umma za Kenya.
Ekegusii: Amasomo gokonya gosoma ebitabu agareigwe goika chisukuru chionsi chieserikari.

English: Live CBC Grade 8 revision marathon starts 4PM daily – join free on KICD YouTube!
Kiswahili: Marathon ya marekebisho ya darasa la 8 ya CBC inaanza saa 4 usiku kila siku jiunge bure kwenye KICD YouTube!
Ekegusii: Amairorero yamasomo a CBC goetera etibi TV kera rituko arengete abana begeredi kia 8 ngochaka are chinsa ikomi chia mogoroba, soa otari goakana kende goetera KICD YouTube!

English: Live Grade 9 CBC revision starts 5PM daily – free on Education YouTube channel!
Kiswahili: Marekebisho ya moja kwa moja ya CBC ya Daraja la 9 huanza saa 5PM kila siku bila malipo kwenye kituo cha Elimu cha YouTube!
Ekegusii: Amasomo yokoirorera amaiso marore ase abana bageredi 9 a CBC ngochaka are chinsa 11 chiamiogoroba kera rituko, chisemi chia bosa goetera YouTube channel!

English: Live KCSE 2025 prediction marathon starts 6PM daily – free on KICD channel!
Kiswahili: Marathon ya utabiri wa moja kwa moja ya KCSE 2025 inaanza saa 12 jioni kila siku bila malipo kwenye kituo cha KICD!
Ekegusii: Amasomo amaiso marore buna ekiorokererio kia ayagochi koba esekenderi KCSE 2025 kera rituko ngochaka ore chinsa 12 chiamogoroba kera rituko, abosa goetera emeroberio ya KICD!

English: Maintain hygiene standards in schools 2024.
Kiswahili: Dumisha viwango vya usafi shuleni 2024.
Ekegusii: Ikerania ebirengo biobochenu ase chisukuru 2024.

English: Maintain playgrounds safely 2021.
Kiswahili: Tunza viwanja vya michezo kwa usalama mwaka 2021.
Ekegusii: Ikerania amchiko ase chiogosori 2021.

English: Maintain school infrastructure 2023.
Kiswahili: Kudumisha miundombinu ya shule 2023.
Ekegusii: Renda oboikeranu bwamaagacho yesukuru 2023.

English: Make schools accessible! Install ramps for disabled students.
Kiswahili: Fanya shule zipatikane! Weka njia panda kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
Ekegusii: Rora ng'a abana bonsi (abaremaru gose bare nokongu ao ao) mbare neribaga gosoa esukuru! Karwe ebinto biria bigonya bari batari konyara gotenenena na kogenda.

English: Modernize learning! Install smart boards in classrooms.
Kiswahili: Boresha ujifunzaji! Sakinisha mbao mahiri darasani.
Ekegusii: Kora ogosoma okoyia! Ibeka ebinto biria biokoererania chinkwana gati yabarimu nabana ase eborore biebirasi ime.

English: Monitor air quality in schools 2024.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia ubora wa hewa shuleni 2024.
Ekegusii: Bwatia komanya nga embeo nengiya esuchuku 2024.

English: Monitor cyberbullying 2023.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia unyanyasaji mtandaoni 2023.
Ekegusii: Bwatia komanya gose abana ngocheganuia bare goetera eintaneti 2023.

English: Monitor dropout rates quarterly 2020.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia viwango vya kuacha shule kila robo mwaka 2020.
Ekegusii: Bwatia komanya ekerengo abana bakogwa amatemwa nyuma yemetienyi 3 omwaka 2020.

English: Monitor exam integrity 2023.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia uadilifu wa mtihani 2023.
Ekegusii: Bwatia komanya oboikeranu bwatemwa omwaka 2023.

English: Monitor learning outcomes 2025.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia matokeo ya kujifunza 2025.
Ekegusii: Bwatia komanya amatokeo yamasomo abana 2025.

English: Monitor nutrition in school feeding programs 2020.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia lishe katika programu za kulisha shuleni 2020.
Ekegusii: Bwatia komanya gose omoroberio bwendagera abana bakoria esukuru ng'a nebwenerate 2020.

English: Monitor nutrition programs 2024.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia programu za lishe 2024.
Ekegusii: Bwatia komanya gose emeroberio bwendagera nobwenerete omwaka 2024.

English: Monitor student attendance post-COVID 2021.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia mahudhurio ya wanafunzi baada ya COVID 2021.
Ekegusii: Bwatia komanya buna abana bagocha esukuru nyuma yendwari yenya'maa - KORONA omwaka 2021.

English: Monitor teacher absenteeism 2023.
Kiswahili: Fuatilia utoro wa walimu 2023.
Ekegusii: Bwatia komanya buna abarimu batari goika esukuru gosomia 2023.

English: More teachers! Support hiring in underserved regions.
Kiswahili: Walimu zaidi! Saidia kuajiri katika maeneo ambayo hayana huduma za kutosha.
Ekegusii: Abarimu abange! Sira omoroberio bwogomboa abarimi chingongo chiria chitari goikereka kebwororo gose konyora obokoreri bweserikari buna ebwenerete.

English: Motivate teachers! Offer bonuses for rural school postings.
Kiswahili: Wahamasishe walimu! Toa bonasi kwa nafasi za shule za vijijini.
Ekegusii: Kae abarimi omoyo! Karwe chinyomba chiokomenya ase abarimu baria bagotomwa gochia chisukuru chia risabu.

English: Multi-agency team monitors school safety during KCSE exams.
Kiswahili: Timu ya mashirika mengi hufuatilia usalama wa shule wakati wa mitihani ya KCSE.
Ekegusii: Etimu ya yechiminisitiri amo nebiombe binde nkorigereria bare igoro yoborendi bwechisukuru ekero chogokora amatemwa esekenderi (KCSE).

English: New Competency-Based Curriculum for TVET launched – download free from KICD.
Kiswahili: Mtaala Mpya Unaozingatia Umahiri wa TVET ulizinduliwa na – pakua bure kutoka KICD.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwokorosia chisemi chiria chirengete okwenyara gwa kera omwana nechisemi chiokwegendereria (CBC) ase cikorechi chiobobundi na tekinorochi (TVET) oansirwe, yonyore bosa korwa KICD.

English: New green-energy TVET curriculum launched – free download on KICD site now!
Kiswahili: Mtaala mpya wa TVET wa nishati ya kijani ulizinduliwa "upakuaji wa bure kwenye tovuti ya KICD sasa!"
Ekegusii: Chikorechi chiobobundi na tekinorochia (TVET) chiaansire omoroberio bwamasomo yechinguru chiomorero chinyia, yanyore bosa korwa omoroberio o'KICD bono!

English: No arson in schools! Keep flammables away from dorms.
Kiswahili: Hakuna uchomaji moto shuleni! Weka vifaa vya kuwaka moto mbali na mabweni.
Ekegusii: Sukuru tichisambwa! Beka omorero are korwa nechinyomba chiokorara.

English: No changes to KCSE 2025 timetable after October 1.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mabadiliko kwenye ratiba ya KCSE 2025 baada ya Oktoba 1.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio buna amatemwa agochia gokorwa KCSE 2025 togootoranwa nyuma yetariki 1 omotienyi 10.

English: No child left behind: 100% transition from primary to secondary enforced nationwide.
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtoto aliyeachwa nyuma: Mpito wa 100% kutoka shule ya msingi hadi shule ya upili unatekelezwa kote nchini.
Ekegusii: Mwana taro oratigare magega: 1Emia ase emia (00%) goika bamboke korwa chisukuru chioboroso gochia chisekenderi obekirwe chinguru onsi Kenya.

English: No child to repeat Grade 6 – automatic promotion to JSS enforced nationwide!
Kiswahili: Hakuna mtoto wa kurudia Daraja la 6 – kupandishwa cheo kiotomatiki kwa JSS kunatekelezwa kote nchini!
Ekegusii: mwana onde tari orairorere egeredi gia 6 korende gosoa ebirasi biechisekenderi chia inse (JSS) yabebikwe chinguri Kenya engima!

English: No delay in school reopening 2025 due to floods.
Kiswahili: Hakuna kuchelewa kwa kufungua shule mwaka 2025 kutokana na mafuriko.
Ekegusii: Konyorwa tikobao ase okoigora chisukuru 2025 ase engencho yetoigo.

English: No entry without uniform and ID from January 6, 2025.
Kiswahili: Hakuna kiingilio bila sare na kitambulisho kuanzia Januari 6, 2025.
Ekegusii: Gosoa tikoiyo onye tobwati eyunifomu nekebande korwa chitariki 6 chiomotienyi 1, omwaka 2025.

English: No fees for public primary – report any demand to 0800721490 immediately!
Kiswahili: Hakuna ada kwa ajili ya shule za msingi za umma toa taarifa kuhusu ombi lolote kwa 0800721490 mara moja!
Ekegusii: Sukuru fisi ende teiyo eraakanwe ase chisukuru chioboroso, karwe amangana igoro yogosabwa besa chinde chionsi goetera enamba yesimi eye 0800721490 erio kegima!

English: No learner to be locked out for lack of uniform – principals warned!
Kiswahili: Hakuna mwanafunzi atakayefungiwa nje kwa kukosa sare za shule, "wakuu wa shule walionya!"
Ekegusii: Mwana onde tari oratangwe gosoa sukuru ekiagera atabwati eyunifomu, barimu abanene baonyirwe

English: No learner to miss school due to fees – call 0800721490 if blocked at the gate.
Kiswahili: Mwanafunzi asikose shule kutokana na ada piga 0800721490 ikiwa amezuiwa langoni.
Ekegusii: Mwana onde tari oraserigwe korwa esukuru ekiagera ataraakana chibesa chiesukuru, eka esimi eye kegima 0800721490 onye gwasiekierwe gotasoa.

English: No learner to walk more than 5km to school – free buses deployed in rural areas!
Kiswahili: Hakuna mwanafunzi anayeruhusiwa kutembea zaidi ya kilomita 5 kwenda shuleni, mabasi ya bure yanapelekwa vijijini!
Ekegusii: No learner to walk more than 5km to school – free buses deployed in rural areas!

English: No violence! Report student issues to school management.
Kiswahili: Hakuna vurugu! Ripoti masuala ya wanafunzi kwa usimamizi wa shule.
Ekegusii: No violence! Report student issues to school management.

English: No visits to secondary schools during third term as per circular.
Kiswahili: Hakuna ziara katika shule za upili wakati wa muhula wa tatu kulingana na waraka.
Ekegusii: No visits to secondary schools during third term as per circular.

English: OMR answer sheets for KPSEA 2025 now use circles instead of lines.
Kiswahili: Karatasi za majibu za OMR za KPSEA 2025 sasa zinatumia miduara badala ya mistari.
Ekegusii: Etekinorochi yokomaki amatemwa ase okororera ritemwa rimakirie (OMR) ase okorenga amatemwa yeschisukuru chioboroso (KPSEA) 2025 bono ata enoti na tari buna yarenge yokongororia.

English: Open doors! Integrate refugee students into national schools.
Kiswahili: Milango wazi! Wajumuishe wanafunzi wakimbizi katika shule za kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Igora emerangu! Anchera abana ba baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo ase chisuluru chinene .

English: Open schools! Enroll refugee children in education.
Kiswahili: Fungua shule! Waandikishe watoto wakimbizi katika elimu.
Ekegusii: Igora chisukuru! Anchera abana ba baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo ase chisemi.

English: Organize career guidance days 2021.
Kiswahili: Panga siku za mwongozo wa kazi 2021.
Ekegusii: Kabe nomoroberio bwerituko riokorwa ogosemia igoro yebinto abana bagochia gosomera 2021.

English: Organize debate clubs 2020.
Kiswahili: Panga vilabu vya mijadala 2020.
Ekegusii: Roberia koba nebiombe biokoenena obosemia 2020.

English: Organize exchange programs 2020.
Kiswahili: Panga programu za kubadilishana 2020.
Ekegusii: Roberia koira abana chisukuru chinde koumerana na korora buna bagosoma 2020.

English: Organize science fairs annually 2022.
Kiswahili: Kuandaa maonyesho ya sayansi kila mwaka 2022.
Ekegusii: Roberia koba nechingaki abana bagocha amo kworokania ebi bamany ire ebiyia ase obosayansi bwabo kera omwaka 2022.

English: Over 1.5 million learners placed in junior secondary – check SMS *222# now.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wanafunzi milioni 1.5 waliojiunga na shule ya upili ya junior angalia SMS *222# sasa.
Ekegusii: Goetania abana bagosoma emirioni eyemo nenusu 1basoire chisekenderi chia'nse, Manya goetera akarube agake gesimi ase ogoaka *222# bono.

English: Over 2 million learners to get free textbooks Jan 6 – no buying allowed!
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wanafunzi milioni 2 watapata vitabu vya kiada bila malipo Januari 6 – hakuna ununuzi unaoruhusiwa!
Ekegusii: Goetania abana chimirioni 2 Bnyore ebitabu biogosoma bosa nyuma yomotienyi omotang'ani, gochegania ngwancheirwe!

English: Parents in arid areas: Apply now for 15,000 secondary school scholarships – deadline Nov 30.
Kiswahili: Wazazi katika maeneo kame: Tuma maombi sasa kwa ufadhili wa masomo 15,000 wa shule za upili tarehe ya mwisho Novemba 30.
Ekegusii: Abaibori bare ase chingongo chinyomo: Toma ogosaba kwogokonywa chibesa chieserikari gosomera esekenderi 15,000, nyuma ya chitariki 30 omotienyi 11.

English: Parents in slums: 50,000 full scholarships available – apply before Nov 30!
Kiswahili: Wazazi katika makazi duni: Ufadhili kamili 50,000 unapatikana – tuma maombi kabla ya Novemba 30!
Ekegusii: Abaiibori bamenyete chirandi: Chisiringi 50,000 chiamasomo amagima nchireo, chisabe nyuma yechitariki 30 omotienyi 11!

English: Parents must register Grade 6 learners for KPSEA by February 28, 2025.
Kiswahili: Wazazi lazima wawaandikishe wanafunzi wa Darasa la 6 kwa KPSEA ifikapo Februari 28, 2025.
Ekegusii: Abaibori goika barike abana babo bageredi 6 ase amaosomo yenasari KPSEA nyuma yechitariki 28 chiomotienyi 2 omwaka 2025.

English: Parents urged to enroll all children in free primary education before January 2025 deadline.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wamehimizwa kuwaandikisha watoto wote katika elimu ya msingi bila malipo kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya Januari 2025.

Kiswahili: Boresha usafi wa mazingira! Toa vyoo salama ili kuzuia kipindupindu.
Ekegusii: Agacha chinyomba chiobochenu chinyia! Beka chichoo chingiya gotanga endwari yogosaa.

English: Upgrade teacher salaries 2020.
Kiswahili: Boresha mishahara ya walimu 2020.
Ekegusii: Gesa abarimu emesaara omwaka 2020.

English: Use digital learning tools in classrooms 2024.
Kiswahili: Tumia zana za kujifunzia kidijitali madarasani 2024.
Ekegusii: Tumia ebinto biosomia biegedichitari ase ebirasi omwaka 2024.

English: Used during Nairobi festivals
Kiswahili: Inatumika wakati wa sherehe za Nairobi
Ekegusii: Yatumegete ekero giechisiri Nairobi.

English: Used in Mandera civic awareness events
Kiswahili: Inatumika katika matukio ya uhamasishaji wa raia Mandera
Ekegusii: Yatumegete Mandera ekero giokomanyia abanto igoro yoboronge bwabo.

English: Vaccinate students against measles 2020.
Kiswahili: Wachanje wanafunzi dhidi ya surua 2020.
Ekegusii: Chancha abana gotanga orwaye omwaka 2020.

English: Vaccinate your child before Jan 6 reopening – polio & measles jab mandatory!
Kiswahili: Chanja mtoto wako kabla ya kufungua tena Januari 6 – chanjo ya polio na surua lazima!
Ekegusii: Chancha abana bao nyuma yechitariki 6 omotienyi omotangani chisukuru gachikoigora, Echancho eye neyarasima!

English: Vaccination cards mandatory at school gate Jan 6 – no jab, no entry!
Kiswahili: Kadi za chanjo lazima kwenye lango la shule Januari 6 – hakuna chanjo, hakuna kuingia!
Ekegusii: Ekadi yogochanchwa nerasima ase egeita giesukuru kogosoa chitariki 6 chimotienyi omotang'ani, onye tochanchiri goasoa tikoiyo!

English: Vaccination mandatory for all boarding students before reopening.
Kiswahili: Video zinaangazia sura za katiba
Ekegusii: Ogochanchwa nerasima ase abana bonsi bechisukuru chiokarara ime nyuma chisukuru chitaraigorwa.

English: Wash hands daily! Prevent cholera with proper hygiene.
Kiswahili: Osha mikono kila siku! Zuia kipindupindu kwa usafi unaofaa.
Ekegusii: Sibia amaboko ao kera rituko! Tanga kendwari yogosaa goetera abochenu bwao.

English: Wash hands, stay safe! Use clean water to prevent cholera in schools.
Kiswahili: Osha mikono, kaa salama! Tumia maji safi kuzuia kipindupindu shuleni.
Ekegusii: Sibia amaboko ao, Kabe sarama! Tumia amache amarabu gotanga endwari yogosaa chisukuru.

English: Welcome all! Enroll refugee students in local schools.
Kiswahili: Karibu nyote! Waandikishe wanafunzi wakimbizi katika shule za mitaa.
Ekegusii: Mwaariganiigwe mwensi! Anchera abana ba baria batamire chisegi korwa sobo gosoa chisukuru.

English: Welcome refugees! Enroll refugee children in local schools.
Kiswahili: Karibuni wakimbizi! Waandikishe watoto wakimbizi katika shule za mitaa.
Ekegusii: Mwaariganiigwe abakimbisi! Anchera abana babakimbisi gosoa chisukuru.

English: Work and learn! Join vocational training at Kiambu Industrial Park.
Kiswahili: Fanya kazi na ujifunze! Jiunge na mafunzo ya ufundi katika Hifadhi ya Viwanda ya Kiambu.
Ekegusii: Kora emeremo kogosoma! Batania ogosoma aaria Ekorechi ya Kiambu Industrial Park yobobundi Nochusi .

English: Work together! Communities, ensure safe school environments.
Kiswahili: Fanya kazi pamoja! Jamii, hakikisha mazingira salama ya shule.
Ekegusii: Kora emeremo amo! Ebinyoro, rora nga okorika kwa abana gosoa chisukuru tikori namochando.

English: Youâ€TMre not alone! Visit school counselors for support.
Kiswahili: Hauko peke yako! Tembelea washauri wa shule kwa usaidizi.
Ekegusii: Tori aye bweka! Rora omosebwa bwabana esukuru agokonye ebirengererio

English: Your vote counts! Learn about elections in school programs.
Kiswahili: Kura yako inahesabika! Jifunze kuhusu uchaguzi katika programu za shule.
Ekegusii: Ekura yao neyengencho! Soma igoro yemeroberio yobochori bweesukuru.

English: Youth Agenda challenges youth to create civic tech solutions.
Kiswahili: Ajenda ya Vijana inawapa changamoto vijana kuunda suluhisho za teknolojia ya kiraia.
Ekegusii: chenda yaasae yabasegetire koreta chisemi chiabo korengana nokagania kwebinyoro biabo.

English: Youth voter registration drive: Visit your school for free ID processing.
Kiswahili: Harakati ya usajili wa wapiga kura kwa vijana: Tembelea shule yako kwa usindikaji wa vitambulisho bila malipo.
Ekegusii: Korika abasae buna abaaki chikura: Tarera esukuru yao ase okwerika konyora ekebande.

English: We are advising all health workers to ensure they are wearing masks and PPEs at all times. Please take all the measures we have announced seriously.
Kiswahili: Tunawashauri wafanyakazi wote wa afya kuhakikisha wamevaa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga wakati wote. Tafadhali chukua hatua zote ambazo tumetangaza kwa uzito.
Ekegusii: Nigo tokobasemia abakori emeremo bonsi ba nyagitari kobeka ebikoneri/chimaski amo n'ebinto biogwetanga chingaki chionsi

English: Restaurants must; 1.ensure quality & safety of food, rinse &sanitize food contact surfaces, disinfect surfaces, floors & counters. 2.Install adequate portable running water & accessible washing basins for hand washing purposes, at the entrance & exit points.
Kiswahili: Mikahawa lazima; 1. kuhakikisha ubora na usalama wa chakula, suuza na usafi wa nyuso zinazogusa chakula, safisha nyuso, sakafu na kaunta. 2. Weka maji ya kutosha yanayobebeka na beseni za kufulia zinazoweza kufikika kwa ajili ya kunawia mikono, kwenye sehemu za kuingilia na za kutokea.
Ekegusii: Chinsemo chiokoragera; 1. chiikeranie obochenu bwe'chindagera, amo n'ebibekerero, amo n'echinsemo chiokooneria. 2. Beka amache aisaine ase chibeseni chiogwesaba, chiranyare goikerwa na kera omonto, ase ebisieri bioosoa, na gosoka.

English: We are advising members of the public to put on masks when getting into a matatu one is advised to put on a mask. Local production of masks and PPEs has began
Kiswahili: Tunawashauri wananchi kuvaa barakoa wanapoingia kwenye matatu, mtu anashauriwa kuvaa barakoa. Uzalishaji wa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga umeanza.
Ekegusii: Nigo tokobasemia abamenyi ense kobeka ebikoneri kekero bagosoa ase chimatatu, omonto nigo agosemigwa kobeka egekoneri/emaski. Oboroisia bw'ebinto biogwetanga bwachakire.

English: This are the first steps to keeping your family safe from Covid 19; 1.Wash your hands regularly with soap & running water 2. Cover your mouth and nose with a flexed elbow or tissue, when coughing or sneezing. 3.Avoid close contact with anyone who has cold or flu-like symptoms
Kiswahili: Hizi ni hatua za kwanza za kulinda familia yako kutokana na Covid 19; 1. Osha mikono yako mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka 2. Funika mdomo na pua yako kwa kiwiko au tishu iliyokunjwa, unapokohoa au kupiga chafya. 3. Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na mtu yeyote ambaye ana dalili za mafua au mafua.
Ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebitambokero ebitangani b i'okorenda enyomba yao korwa ase Covid 19; 1.Esibie amaboko ao ase n'amache y'egetacho, n'esabuni. 2.Tuba omonu ne'chimioro kogotumia ekegokoro kiao gose egetambaa ekero ogokorora gose goasimora. 3.Toba ang'e na omonto o nde bwensi obwate rikuba.

English: Alcohol and Smoking will increase the risks of having high blood pressure. While you STAY AT HOME reduce alcohol intake and smoking.
Kiswahili: Pombe na Uvutaji Sigara vitaongeza hatari za kuwa na shinikizo la damu. Unapokaa NYUMBANI punguza unywaji wa pombe na uvutaji sigara.
Ekegusii: Amarwa n'esigara nigo bikomenta obokong'u bw'okonyora riberera riamanyinga. Ekero ore inka, keia konywa amaru gose konywa esigara.

English: Be safe from coronavirus.Washing your hands is the most important way to stop transmission. 1.Wet hands 2.Apply enough soap 3.Scrub all surfaces of the hands for 20-30 seconds. 4.Rinse thoroughly with running water 5.Dry hands with a clean cloth or single-use towel
Kiswahili: Kuwa salama kutokana na virusi vya corona. Kuosha mikono yako ndiyo njia muhimu zaidi ya kuzuia maambukizi. 1. Lowesha mikono 2. Paka sabuni ya kutosha 3. Sugua sehemu zote za mikono kwa sekunde 20-30. 4. Suuza vizuri na maji yanayotiririka 5. Kausha mikono kwa kitambaa safi au taulo ya matumizi moja
Ekegusii: Etange n'ebinyinyi bia Corona. Gosibia amaboko nenchera ya bene yogotanga ogoetia kwebinyinyi. 1.Esibi amaboko 2.Eyake esabuni 3.Sugua kera ensemo yokoboko ase chisekunde 20-30 4.Sibi amaboko ase amache egetacho 5.Etinyi n'egetambaa ekerabu

English: How to boost your immune system against the COVID-19; 1. Stay hydrated - drink 3-4 litres of water daily. 2. Take antioxidant-rich diet - amla, guava, green leafy veggies, spinach, garlic, green tea, peppers, turmeric 3. Exercise 4. Meditation 5. Quality sleep
Kiswahili: Jinsi ya kuimarisha kinga yako dhidi ya COVID-19; 1. Endelea kuwa na maji mwilini - kunywa lita 3-4 za maji kila siku. 2. Chukua lishe yenye vioksidishaji vingi - amla, guava, mboga za majani mabichi, mchicha, kitunguu saumu, chai ya kijani, pilipili hoho, manjano 3. Mazoezi 4. Kutafakari 5. Usingizi bora
Ekegusii: Enchera yokomenta ogwetanga korwa Covid 19 1.Kanywe amache amange - chilita 3-4 kera rituko 2.Kari chindagera buna amapera, chinyeni chiekegusii, egetunguo saumu, n.k 3.Tarataria omobere 4.Okoiranerera 5.Chitoro chiisaine

English: You have to be registered to get the COVID-19 vaccine. You can do this at the nearest health facility or be registering on the MOH_Kenya website (http://health.go.ke). All you need is your ID card. Kindly assist your elderly relatives to get registered
Kiswahili: Lazima uwe umesajiliwa ili kupata chanjo ya COVID-19. Unaweza kufanya hivi katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu au kujiandikisha kwenye tovuti ya MOH_Kenya (http://health.go.ke). Unachohitaji ni kitambulisho chako. Tafadhali wasaidie jamaa zako wazee kujiandikisha.
Ekegusii: Goika bwerike erio konyora esindani ya Covid 19. Nabo okwerika ase enyagitari ere ang'e nasore, gose ase etuvuti ya MOH_Kenya (http://health.go.ke). Ekio oganetie nekebande kiao. Konya abakoro kwerika.

English: Health CS Mutahi Kagwe says total lockdown on the table if coronavirus cases escalate, urges Kenyans to limit social interactions.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe anasema amri ya kutotoka nje ikiwa visa vya virusi vya corona vitaongezeka, anawahimiza Wakenya kupunguza mwingiliano wa kijamii.
Ekegusii: Omowaziri o Afya, Mutahi Kagwe otebire richiko riogotasoka isiko ndietigwe onye ebinyinyi bia Coronavirus bikomentekana, obasabire abakenya gokeania okoumerana na abande.

English: Covid-19 variant from India detected in Kenya, MoH says the case was reported in Kisumu.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inasema kisa hicho kiliripotiwa Kisumu, aina ya Covid-19 kutoka India ikigunduliwa nchini Kenya.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yoborwaria yatebire ebinyinyi bia Covid 19 koru India biatokire Kisumu

English: A small number of vaccinated people may get infected with COVID-19 after vaccination; this is called a breakthrough infection, but they are likely to have milder symptoms than if they were not vaccinated.
Kiswahili: Idadi ndogo ya watu waliochanjwa wanaweza kuambukizwa COVID-19 baada ya chanjo; hii inaitwa maambukizi ya mafanikio, lakini kuna uwezekano wa kuwa na dalili ndogo kuliko kama hawakuchanjwa.
Ekegusii: Enamba enke ya abanto mbakageire konyora oborwaire bwa Covid 19 magega yokonyora esindani yogwetanga. Eye nigo ekorokwa okoambokerigwa kwobobui, nonya abanto aba bagotwara ebimanyererio ebike kobua bari bataranyora esindani.

English: All COVID-19 vaccines are safe for use by adults, breastfeeding mothers and as per current WHO guidelines, can also be used by pregnant women upon recommendation by a qualified physician.
Kiswahili: Chanjo zote za COVID-19 ni salama kwa matumizi ya watu wazima, akina mama wanaonyonyesha na kulingana na miongozo ya sasa ya WHO, zinaweza pia kutumiwa na wanawake wajawazito kwa mapendekezo ya daktari aliyehitimu.
Ekegusii: Chisindani chia Covid 19 chionsi nechingiya ase okobetwa abanto abanene, abang'ina/abakungu bakogonkia kobwatekana namorokererio arure na WHO. Nabo chikoegwa abakungu bare morito, koreng'ana nogoetia k w'omonyagitari.

English: Taking different types of vaccines is not recommended. After being fully vaccinated you will obtain your COVID-19 certificate from the MOH website https://portal.health.go.ke.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua aina tofauti za chanjo haipendekezwi. Baada ya kuchanjwa kikamilifu utapata cheti chako cha COVID-19 kutoka kwa tovuti ya MOH https://portal.health.go.ke.
Ekegusii: Kobetwa chisindani cao ao teancheiri. Ekero kwanyorire esindani, nabo okonyora esatibigeti yao ya COVI-19 korwa ase omtandao o MOH https://portal.health.go.ke

English: Five new Mpox cases detected in Kenya, one patient in isolation
Kiswahili: Visa vitano vipya vya Mpox vyagunduliwa nchini Kenya, mgonjwa mmoja akiwa ametengwa
Ekegusii: Abanto batano batokire babwate oborwaire bwa Mpox igaa Kenya. Omorwaire oyomo orusananigwe

English: Key causes of TB include undernutrition, HIV, alcohol use disorders, smoking, and diabetes. Get the word out! We can eradicate TB together
Kiswahili: Sababu kuu za Kifua Kikuu ni pamoja na lishe duni, VVU, matatizo ya matumizi ya pombe, uvutaji sigara, na kisukari. Fahamu! Tunaweza kutokomeza Kifua Kikuu pamoja
Ekegusii: Esese nigo ekorentwa na ogotaragera buya, enyamoreo, obotindu bwa amaru, esigara amo noborwaire bwesukari. Raria eng'ana eye! Ase oboamo nabo togokora esese

English: Coughing! Fever! Night sweats! Chest pains! Weight loss! You could have TB. Testing and treatment are free at all public hospitals!Get tested today!
Kiswahili: Kikohozi! Homa! Jasho la usiku! Maumivu ya kifua! Kupunguza uzito! Unaweza kuwa na TB. Upimaji na matibabu ni bure katika hospitali zote za umma! Pima leo!
Ekegusii: Ogokorora! Riberera! Kogiramora botuko! Goatigwa egekuba! Gokea omobere! Nabo oratware Esese. Ogopimwa na oborwaria nigo bokoenanwa bosa ase chinyagitari chieserekali! Pimwa rero!

English: To get cured of TB, you must complete the entire course of treatment as advised by the health worker.
Kiswahili: Ili kupona kifua kikuu, ni lazima ukamilishe matibabu yote kama ilivyoshauriwa na mfanyakazi wa afya.
Ekegusii: Erio obwene esese, goika okore oborwaria buna ogosemigwa nomonyagitaro oo.

English: Key points to stop Mpox spread: Avoid close contact with individuals showing symptoms. Do not share personal items like towels, utensils, or clothing. Maintain good hygiene by washing hands frequently.
Kiswahili: Mambo muhimu ya kuzuia kuenea kwa Mpox: Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na watu wanaoonyesha dalili. Usishiriki vitu vya kibinafsi kama vile taulo, vyombo, au nguo. Dumisha usafi mzuri kwa kunawa mikono mara kwa mara.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana yengencho yogotanga Mpox: Tiga goikana ang'e nabanto babwate ebimanyererio bioborwaire obo. Timosanga ebinto bia ime buna chitauro, ebinto biendagera, gose chianga. Kaba omochenu ase ogwesibi amaboko ao kera chingaki.

English: Mpox symptoms include fever, rash, and swollen lymph nodes. Seek medical care immediately if you notice any of these.
Kiswahili: Dalili za Mpox ni pamoja na homa, upele, na uvimbe wa tezi za limfu. Tafuta huduma ya matibabu mara moja ikiwa utagundua yoyote kati ya haya.
Ekegusii: Ebimanyererio bia Mpox nigo bire buna rikuba, upele, okobimba chingw'eno. Genda nyagitari kegima ekero kwarorire ebimanyererio ebi ase ore.

English: Mpox outbreak in Mombasa. Two people have died from Monkey Pox disease. Mombasa County has reported 98 Monkey Pox cases. There is a lot of active community transmission
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa Mpox Mombasa. Watu wawili wamefariki kutokana na ugonjwa wa Tumbili. Kaunti ya Mombasa imeripoti visa 98 vya Tumbili. Kuna maambukizi mengi ya kijamii yanayoendelea
Ekegusii: Oborwaire bwa bwatokire MPOX Mombasa Ekaunti ya Mombasa yaripotiri abanto emerongo kianda na isano isato gotwara oborwaire Bwa MPOX naboigo babere gosira kobwatia oborwaire obo na kogenderera koambokera abande abange.

English: Ban on all public gatherings extended to May 29 to curb the spread of Covid-19.
Kiswahili: Marufuku ya mikusanyiko yote ya umma yaongezwa hadi Mei 29 ili kupunguza kuenea kwa Covid-19.
Ekegusii: Ogokanwa kwemesangererekano ao ao gosukigwa goika omotienyi o gatano 29, erio gokeyia Covid 19

English: Kenya confirms 10 more Covid-19 cases bringing the total number of confirmed infections to 384, nine of the new cases are from Mombasa and one from Nairobi
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa 10 zaidi vya Covid-19 na kufikisha jumla ya maambukizi 384, tisa kati ya visa vipya ni kutoka Mombasa na kimoja kutoka Nairobi.
Ekegusii: Kenya koenekia abanto 10 komentekana ase okoambokerigwa oborwaire bwa COVID19 bonsi amo goika abanto 384. Ase abwo, 109 nigo bakorwa Mombasa na oyomo korwa Nairobi.

English: I have invoked the public health act after it was declared a pandemic. Thoroughly wash hands and use alcohol based sanitizers. Keep 1-meter distance from a person who is sneezing or coughing. A person who is coughing or sneezing should stay at home and avoid crowds
Kiswahili: Nimeitisha sheria ya afya ya umma baada ya kutangazwa kuwa janga. Osha mikono vizuri na utumie vitakasa mikono vyenye pombe. Weka umbali wa mita 1 kutoka kwa mtu anayepiga chafya au kukohoa. Mtu anayekohoa au kupiga chafya anapaswa kukaa nyumbani na kuepuka misongamano ya watu.
Ekegusii: Natianirie richiko riobochenu bwensekobwatekana nogotangaswa kwegiateko. Esabe amaboko gotumia chisanitaisa. Tenena oboare bwemita eyemo koru ase omonto ogokorora na goasimora. Omonto ogokorora na goasimora nigo agwenerete kobera nyomba, aare nemesangererekano yabanto.

English: Kenya on high alert over new and deadly mosquito. Anopheles Stephensi causes the deadliest type of Malaria. Health researchers have found the mosquito in Mandera. Mosquito spreads Malaria in both urban and rural areas
Kiswahili: Kenya iko macho kuhusu mbu mpya na hatari. Anopheles Stephensi husababisha aina mbaya zaidi ya Malaria. Watafiti wa afya wamegundua mbu huko Mandera. Mbu hueneza Malaria katika maeneo ya mijini na vijijini
Ekegusii: Kenya yakureire eumbu yachire embe. Anopheles Stephensi nigo ekoreta esosera embe. Abakori emeremo boborwaria banyorire eumbu eye aaria Mandera. Chiumbu nigo chikoenana esosera ase chinsemo ao ao ime y'emechi, n'ebinyoro.

English: Kisumu Governor Nyong'o orders all restaurants shut in the county for failing to adhere to MoH measures against Covid-19.
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Kisumu Nyong'o aamuru migahawa yote ifungwe katika kaunti hiyo kwa kushindwa kufuata sheria za Wizara ya Afya dhidi ya Covid-19.
Ekegusii: Omogabana o Kisumu, Nyong'o, orure richiko riogosieka chinsemo chiokoragera magega yogotaigwera amachiko arure na MOH yokorwania COVID 19

English: CDC launches a campaign promoting hand hygiene to prevent disease spread.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya kuhimiza usafi wa mikono ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa.
Ekegusii: CDC gochaka ekampeini ya ogosiira gosibia amaboko erio gotanga okoambokeria amarwaire.

English: State launches Kenya National Public Health Institute to bolster disease prevention
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua Taasisi ya Kitaifa ya Afya ya Umma ya Kenya ili kuimarisha kinga dhidi ya magonjwa
Ekegusii: Eserekali yachakirie etaasisi yoborwaria ime ya Kenya yogokinia ogotanga kw'amarwaire

English: If you fee unweel, have a cold, a cough or fever, please call 719 or text *719#
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unajisikia vibaya, una mafua, kikohozi au homa, tafadhali piga simu 719 au tuma ujumbe mfupi *719#
Ekegusii: Onye koigwete bobe omobere, obwate rikuba gose ogokorora, gaki aka esimi gochia 719 gose otome riuko gochia *719#

English: During this time, prisoners and remandees will not be presented to court.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu, wafungwa na mahabusu hawatafikishwa mahakamani.
Ekegusii: Ebiro ebi, abasibwa namabusi bonsi tibakoirwa bosio bwekegambero.

English: Courts will continue to handle certificates of urgency and taking plea for serious cases.
Kiswahili: Mahakama zitaendelea kushughulikia vyeti vya dharura na kupokea malalamiko ya kesi kubwa.
Ekegusii: Ebigambero biagendereire kobwata chisatibigeti chiobwango na korwa ebirero ase ebina ebinene

English: Judges in all stations will in the meantime review the deserving cases already identified by Prisons authorities and issue appropriate revision orders in an effort to decongest the prisons. Magistrate Courts will also review bail terms for those in remand.
Kiswahili: Majaji katika vituo vyote kwa wakati huo huo watapitia kesi zinazostahili ambazo tayari zimetambuliwa na mamlaka ya Magereza na kutoa amri zinazofaa za marekebisho katika juhudi za kupunguza msongamano wa magereza. Mahakama za Mahakimu pia zitapitia masharti ya dhamana kwa wale walio mahabusu.
Ekegusii: Abanachi ebina ase ebitaseni bionsi, ase chingaki echio, nigo baraetere ebina biganeiri korigererigwa, biancheraneirwe nobogambi bwechichera, na korua amachiko agwenerete yoboonchoreria, erio gokeania ogoichorerana ime yechichera. Ebigambero bia abanachi ebina abake mbaetere amachiko yechibondi ase bari bare oromande

English: The Nyeri ELRC is closed from 24th August to 7th September 2020 due to two confirmed COVID-19 cases, with fumigation and staff self-quarantine underway. No certificates will be processed during this period. The court will reopen for virtual hearings on 21st September, with physical hearings expected to resume under the Presiding Judge's supervision in early October.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha ELRC cha Nyeri kimefungwa kuanzia tarehe 24 Agosti hadi 7 Septemba 2020 kutokana na visa viwili vilivyothibitishwa vya COVID-19, huku dawa ya kufukiza na kujitenga kwa wafanyakazi kukiwa kunaendelea. Hakuna vyeti vitakavyoshughulikiwa katika kipindi hiki. Mahakama itafunguliwa tena kwa ajili ya vikao vya mtandaoni tarehe 21 Septemba, huku vikao vya kimwili vikitarajiwa kuanza tena chini ya usimamizi wa Jaji Mkuu mapema Oktoba.
Ekegusii: Egetuo kia ELCR kia Nyeri giasiekirwe gochakera chitariki 24 Agosti goika 7 Septemba 2020 magega yogotoka abarwaire babere ba COVID-19, ogosiara eriogo na gwesiekerera kogendererete. Chisatibigeti tichirikorosigwa chingaki echi. Abigambero nkoigora bire ogotegerera ebina ase embeo 21 Septemba, ekero ogotegerera ebina ase ebigambero gokageire koirana, inse yoboteneneri bwomogambi omonene, Oktoba kegochaka.

English: Kenya reports record daily jump in Covid-19 cases; 123 new infections from 3,077 samples tested.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaripoti ongezeko kubwa la visa vya Covid-19 kila siku; maambukizi mapya 123 kutoka kwa sampuli 3,077 zilizopimwa.
Ekegusii: Kenya koripoti okomentekana okonene ase okoambokera gwa COVID-19 kera rituko; Ase ebipimo 3,077,123 biatokire koba na ebinyinyi bia COVID -19

English: Trump's policy hits Kenyan health initiatives. Policy halts supply of HIV, Malaria and TB drugs. Move also affects medical supplies of newborn babies. Barasa: We'll look for funding elsewhere if US pulls ou
Kiswahili: Sera ya Trump inaathiri mipango ya afya ya Kenya. Sera inasimamisha usambazaji wa dawa za VVU, Malaria na TB. Hatua hiyo pia inaathiri vifaa vya matibabu vya watoto wachanga. Barasa: Tutatafuta ufadhili kwingineko ikiwa Marekani itaondoa
Ekegusii: Richiko ria Trump, gosaria emeroberio ya oborwaria ya Kenya. Richiko erio nigo rigotenenia obokonyi bwokoenana amariogo ya esese amo na enyamoreo ,naboigo amariogo ya abana ebing'werere. Barasa: Ntorigie obokonyi ase ang'ao Amerika keratenenie obokonyi gocha ase tore.

English: Nigerian company to make HIV, malaria test kits after US funding cut
Kiswahili: Kampuni ya Nigeria kutengeneza vifaa vya kupima VVU na malaria baada ya ufadhili wa Marekani kupunguzwa
Ekegusii: Ekambani ya Nigeria korosia ebikoreri biokorenga oborwaire bw'Enyamoreo na Esosera kobwatekania na Amerika gotenenia obokonyi.

English: Global Fund CEO requests Ruto to mobilise funds for HIV, TB & malaria
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Mfuko wa Kimataifa amtaka Ruto kuchangisha fedha kwa ajili ya VVU, Kifua Kikuu na Malaria
Ekegusii: Omonene o Global Fund komosaba omonene bwe ense Ruto,gochanga chibesa ase okorwania Enyamoreo,Esese na Esosera.

English: Kenya faces crisis as Trump's Executive Order to cut supply of HIV, malaria drugs
Kiswahili: Kenya inakabiliwa na mgogoro huku amri ya Trump ikipunguza usambazaji wa dawa za HIV na malaria
Ekegusii: Kenya konyora obokongu kobuatia richiko ria Trump rgotenenia obokonyi bwamariogo ya Esosera na Enyamoreo

English: KEMRI study shows ivermectin significantly reduces malaria transmission
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa KEMRI unaonyesha ivermectin hupunguza kwa kiasi kikubwa maambukizi ya malaria
Ekegusii: Oboringoria bwa KEMRI bwaenekirie ing'a Ivermectin nigo egokeania okwambokeria gw'Esosera ase engecho enene.

English: Health PS distributes mosquito nets in Busia County. Malaria prevalence in Busia stands at 39%. 22 counties targeted in latest campaign
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Afya asambaza vyandarua katika Kaunti ya Busia. Kiwango cha malaria huko Busia kimefikia 39%. Kaunti 22 zimelengwa katika kampeni ya hivi karibuni
Ekegusii: Omoriki omonene bw'ewizara y'Oborwaria koenana chineti ase ekaunti ya Busia.Ogoichora Kwa Esosera ase ekaunti ya Busia gwaikeire 39%.Chikaunti 22 chirengire ase chikampeini chia ang,'e iga.

English: The cost of targeted testing for Covid-19 and government quarantine facilities shall be met by the government effective today. Kenyans should not be afraid to get tested
Kiswahili: Gharama ya upimaji unaolengwa wa Covid-19 na vituo vya karantini vya serikali italipwa na serikali kuanzia leo. Wakenya hawapaswi kuogopa kupimwa.
Ekegusii: Rigori riogopimwa naboigo ebitaseni bia COVID-19, mbiakanerwe na eserekari gochaka rero ase igo bakenya mbabwenereti gotwara bwoba gopimwa.

English: Cessation of movement in Nairobi Metropolitan Area, Mombasa and Mandera extended by a month, bars to remain closed for another 30 days
Kiswahili: Kusitishwa kwa usafiri katika Eneo la Jiji la Nairobi, Mombasa na Mandera kwaongezwa kwa mwezi mmoja, baa zitaendelea kufungwa kwa siku 30 zaidi
Ekegusii: Ogotenenenigwa bw'obosombi ase emechi ya Nairobi ,Mombasa na Mandera komentwa omotienyi oyomo. Chibaa kogenderera gosiekwa ase amatuko 30 ande.

English: Today, we have recorded 447 new positive cases out of 3803 samples bringing the total of positive cases in the country to 8,975. Tested samples in the country are now over 200,000
Kiswahili: Leo, tumerekodi visa vipya 447 chanya kati ya sampuli 3803 na kufikisha jumla ya visa chanya nchini kufikia 8,975. Sampuli zilizojaribiwa nchini sasa zina zaidi ya 200,000.
Ekegusii: Rero, twanyorire abarwaire 447 ase abanto 3803 banyarire gopimwa, bonsi banyarire goikia abarwaire 8,975. Chisampuli chionsi chiapimirwe ime y'nse yaito engima chiaetanirie 200,000

English: Gov't extends nationwide curfew, ban on public gatherings until May 29
Kiswahili: Serikali yaongeza muda wa kutotoka nje nchini kote, kupiga marufuku mikusanyiko ya umma hadi Mei 29
Ekegusii: Eserekali komenta amatuko y'ekafyu, na gotenenia emesangererekano ao ao goika May 29

English: 2,169 people test positive for COVID-19 from 9,428 samples, positivity rate at 23pc; MoH says no death recorded
Kiswahili: Watu 2,169 wamepatikana na virusi vya COVID-19 kutoka kwa sampuli 9,428, kiwango cha walioambukizwa kikiwa asilimia 23; Wizara ya Afya yasema hakuna kifo kilichorekodiwa
Ekegusii: Abanto 2,169 banyorekanire babwate ebinyinyi bia COVID-19, korwa ase chisampuli 9,428, ekerengo kia abaambokerigwe kere 23%; Ewizara y'Oborwaria yatebire gokwa nkoiyo kwabeire.

English: Magoha says Ksh.1B needed to buy masks for schools
Kiswahili: Magoha anasema Ksh.1B zinahitajika kununua barakoa kwa ajili ya shule
Ekegusii: Magoha otebire Ksh.1B chiganeirie kogorera chisukuru ebikoneri/chimaski

English: There will be no air-lifting people from counties to Nairobi…There will be no capacity to be brought to Nairobi for treatment as Nairobi itself will be already overwhelmed…Where we are heading is unpredictable. It is better to be ready than to be sorry
Kiswahili: Hakutakuwa na watu wanaosafiri kwa ndege kutoka kaunti hadi Nairobi…Hakutakuwa na uwezo wa kuletwa Nairobi kwa matibabu kwani Nairobi yenyewe itakuwa tayari imezidiwa…Tunakoelekea hakutabiriki. Ni bora kuwa tayari kuliko kujuta.
Ekegusii: Obosombi bwa abanto g oetera chindege gocha Nairobi tikoiyo. Okonyara tigokoba aroro gwokorentwa Nairobi erio konyora oborwari, asengencho Nairobi yoka yanyarekire. Ase torochi tarikonyara kobanwa. Nigo ere buya kwebanga kobua gweitia.

English: Nationwide dusk to dawn curfew extended by 21 days in a bid to tame Covid-19 spread
Kiswahili: Amri ya kutotoka nje ya nchi nzima kuanzia jioni hadi alfajiri yaongezwa kwa siku 21 ili kupunguza kuenea kwa Covid-19
Ekegusii: Richiko riogotasoka isiko ase ense engima, gochakera morogoba, goika bwakiire, riamentirwe amatuko 21 erio gokeani okoambokerigwa gwa Covid-19

English: 20 doctors from Cuba set to arrive in Nairobi tonight, Health CS Kagwe says they will be stationed at Kenyatta University Hospital for 6 months to help manage the Covid-19 pandemic.
Kiswahili: Madaktari 20 kutoka Cuba wanatarajiwa kuwasili Nairobi usiku wa leo, Waziri wa Afya Kagwe anasema watakuwa katika Hospitali ya Chuo Kikuu cha Kenyatta kwa miezi 6 ili kusaidia kudhibiti janga la Covid-19.
Ekegusii: Abanyagitari 20 korwa Cuba mbakageire goika Nairobi obotuko bwa rero, Omowaziri bw'Oborwaria, Kagwe, otebire ing'a nigo barabe ase enyagitari ya Kenyatta University, ime y'emetienyi 6 erio gokonya gokeania oborwaire bwa Covid-19.

English: Launch of fortified maize, soy blend distributed across primary schools to address undernutrition.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mchanganyiko wa mahindi na soya ulioimarishwa umesambazwa katika shule za msingi ili kukabiliana na utapiamlo.
Ekegusii: Okorentwa kw'ebituma biburukaine esoya kwararigwe chisukuru chia premari erio gokeania oborwaire bwokoborwa afya

English: Launch of voluntary certification recognizing employers who implement nutrition, mental health, and fitness standards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa cheti cha hiari kinachowatambua waajiri wanaotekeleza viwango vya lishe, afya ya akili, na siha.
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa gw'esatibigeti yokwerwa eyio egoancherana abariki emeremo abare bagoikerania ebirengo biechindagera, oborwari bw'obongo, amo na okoba nechinguru kemobere.

English: Introduction of postpartum exercise and nutrition support groups led by physiotherapists and dietitians.
Kiswahili: Utangulizi wa mazoezi ya baada ya kujifungua na vikundi vya usaidizi wa lishe vinavyoongozwa na wataalamu wa tiba ya viungo na wataalamu wa lishe.
Ekegusii: Ogochakigwa amazoezi/ogotarataria omobere amo na ebiombe bigokonya chisemi chiechindagera, bikorawa na abanyagitari bogotarataria amo na bari bechindagera

English: Announcement encouraging daily consumption of five fruit/veg portions for wellness and disease prevention.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kuhimiza ulaji wa kila siku wa sehemu tano za matunda/mboga kwa ajili ya ustawi na kinga dhidi ya magonjwa.
Ekegusii: Okoraria kwogosegeta gwa kera rituko, gwokoria amatunda keboikeranu/ching'eni erio kkoba buya kemobere na gotanga amarwaire.

English: Pilot providing mobile seed kits and training to women's groups to grow nutritious food in informal settlements.
Kiswahili: Pilot akitoa vifaa vya mbegu vinavyohamishika na mafunzo kwa vikundi vya wanawake ili kukuza chakula chenye lishe katika makazi yasiyo rasmi.
Ekegusii: Omorundi chindege okorwa ebikoreri biechintetere am na koegeria ebiombe bia abakungu gosimeka chindagera chibwate amadini ase babegete obomenyo.

English: The government has imposed a raft of new drastic measures after cases of the new coronavirus in Kenya jumped to 15 in the last 72 hours. The new directives came after eight more people tested positive for COVID-19
Kiswahili: Serikali imeweka hatua kadhaa kali baada ya visa vya virusi vipya vya korona nchini Kenya kupanda hadi 15 katika saa 72 zilizopita. Maagizo hayo mapya yalikuja baada ya watu wengine wanane kupimwa na kupatikana na COVID-19.
Ekegusii: Eserekali yabekireebitambokero ekero ebinyinyi ebinyia bia Korona biamentekanete goika 15 ime ye'chinsa 72 chiaetire. Amachiko amayia nigo achete magega yabanto bande batano na batato gopimwa na konyorekana na COVID-19.

English: Kenya confirms three cases of Covid-19 Omicron variant; Health CS Kagwe says it has been detected among travelers who have been quarantined
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vya Covid-19 Omicron; Waziri wa Afya Kagwe anasema imegunduliwa miongoni mwa wasafiri ambao wametengwa
Ekegusii: Kenya yaenekirie ebinyinyi bitato ao ao bia Covid-19 Omicron; omowaziri bwoborwaria CS Kagwe otebire nigo biarorekanete ase abanto barenge chisafari abare babekire karantini.

English: Kakamega County gov't orders closure of all public mortuaries, Governor Oparanya advises residents to bury their dead immediately.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Kakamega yaamuru kufungwa kwa vyumba vyote vya kuhifadhia maiti vya umma, Gavana Oparanya awashauri wakazi kuzika wafu wao mara moja.
Ekegusii: Eserekali y'ekaunti ya Kakamega yarure ogochika kwogosieka chimocheri chi'echinyagitari chieserekali, Omogabana Oparanya oboririe abamenyi gotindeka abakure kegima.

English: Education CS Magoha says colleges and universities to remain closed until January 2021 as they are not Covid-19 compliant
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu Magoha asema vyuo vikuu vitafungwa hadi Januari 2021 kwani havifuati sheria za Covid-19
Ekegusii: Omowaziri bwe'Chisemi Magoha otebire chi'yunibasiti tichirikoigorwa goika January 2021 ase eng'encho tibarabwatia amachiko a Covid-19

English: Gov't orders Mama Mbogas to stop chopping vegetables for customers over COVID-19 fears
Kiswahili: Serikali yamwagiza Mama Mbogas kuacha kukata mboga kwa ajili ya wateja wake kutokana na hofu ya COVID-19
Ekegusii: Eserekali yatebiririe mama mboga gotiga gokenyeri abanto ching'eni ase eng'encho y'obwoba bwa COVID-19

English: For now, open bars and test social distancing. KCPE and KCSE are not a ticket to heaven
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, fungua baa na jaribu umbali wa kijamii. KCPE na KCSE si tiketi ya kwenda mbinguni
Ekegusii: Ase bonoiga, toigore chibaa, amo na kobera are korwa ase abaminto. KCPE na KCSE tibiri tikiti chiokogenda igoro.

English: Gov't now calls for wearing of masks, vaccination as Kenya faces 6th COVID-19 wave
Kiswahili: Serikali sasa yatoa wito wa kuvaa barakoa na chanjo huku Kenya ikikabiliwa na wimbi la 6 la COVID-19
Ekegusii: Eserekali yabasabire abanto kobeka chimaski na konyora chanjo, ekero Kenya yatubirwe ne'rire ria COVID-19

English: Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: Contactless testing booths to be distributed in 6 constituencies. Booths have zero contact between the medic and patient. Contactless booths allow for safer, faster mass testing. The locally assembled booths are a game changer
Kiswahili: Vibanda vya Mombasa Covid-19: Vibanda vya kupima bila kugusa vitasambazwa katika majimbo 6 ya uchaguzi. Vibanda havina mguso wowote kati ya daktari na mgonjwa. Vibanda visivyogusa vinaruhusu upimaji salama na wa haraka wa wingi. Vibanda vilivyokusanyika ndani ya eneo husika vinabadilisha mchezo.
Ekegusii: Ebisa bia Mombasa Covid-19: Ebisa biogopimwa otarigokunwa nkoenanu bire ase amajimbo 6 y'obochori. Ebisa tibibwati gokunana konde gwonsi gati y'omonyagitari amo n'omorwaire. Ebisa ebi nigo bigoachera ogopimwa kobwate oborendi naende kwa bwango na obonge. Ebisa ebi biroseiri ime y'ensemo eyuo biaonchorire egosori.

English: Schools to remain open despite a surge in Covid-19 infection rates
Kiswahili: Shule zitabaki wazi licha ya ongezeko la viwango vya maambukizi ya Covid-19
Ekegusii: Chisukuru nchigenderere koigorwa nonya ebiwango biokoambokerigwa gwa Covid-19 bigendererete gokiina

English: Kenya suspends all public gatherings, games, events, and church crusades; inter school games banned after first covid-19 case in Nairobi
Kiswahili: Kenya yasimamisha mikusanyiko yote ya umma, michezo, matukio, na mikutano ya kanisa; michezo ya shule imepigwa marufuku baada ya kisa cha kwanza cha COVID-19 jijini Nairobi
Ekegusii: Kenya yatenenirie emesangererekano yonsi, emechieso/chigosori, ebipindi, n'emesangererekano ye'chikanisa; chigosori chiechisukuru chiakanirwe, magega yogotoka ekesi egetang'ani gia COVID-19 ime y'omochie o Nairobi

English: Coronavirus: A lockdown in Kenya is an option, but taxes won't be lifted
Kiswahili: Virusi vya Korona: Kufungiwa nchini Kenya ni chaguo, lakini kodi hazitaondolewa
Ekegusii: Ebinyinyi bia Korona: Gosiekerwa nyomba ime ya ense ya Kenya n'ogochora, korende goakana ekodi tigokorusigwa.

English: Governor Joho sets up sanitizing booths for pedestrians in Mombasa.
Kiswahili: Gavana Joho aweka vibanda vya usafi kwa watembea kwa miguu Mombasa.
Ekegusii: Omogabana Joho obekeire ebisa bi'obochenu ase abanto bagotara namagoro Mombasa

English: Over 80% of patients are asymptomatic and can be treated from home. MoH has completed process of home-based care protocols. I appeal to Kenyans, that when we release the protocols and we see people coming home, there is no need for stigmatization
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya 80% ya wagonjwa hawana dalili na wanaweza kutibiwa nyumbani. Wizara ya Afya imekamilisha mchakato wa itifaki za utunzaji wa nyumbani. Ninawasihi Wakenya, kwamba tunapotoa itifaki hizo na tunaona watu wakirudi nyumbani, hakuna haja ya unyanyapaa.
Ekegusii: Abarwairengoetania 80% mbabwati biorokererio naende nabo bakorwarigwa bagende chinka. Ewizara y'Oborwari yakorire korosia amachiko y'obokonyi bwa inka. Nigo nkobasaba abakenya, ekero torarwe omoroberio oyo naende torore abanto bakoirana inka, titobachecheria.

English: Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru counties are individually and collectively declared a disease infected area. There shall be a cessation of movement by road, rail, air in to & out of these areas effective midnight
Kiswahili: Kaunti za Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu na Nakuru zimetangazwa kuwa eneo lililoathiriwa na magonjwa moja moja na kwa pamoja. Kutakuwa na kusimamishwa kwa usafiri kwa barabara, reli, hewa kuingia na kutoka katika maeneo haya kuanzia saa sita usiku.
Ekegusii: Chikaunti chia Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos na Nakuru chiatangasirwe koba chinsemo ase amarwaire akwambokera mono. Ogotenenigwa gw'okoira gwa para, egari yomorero, chindege gwatenenigwe gochakera chinsa isano na emo chia botuko.

English: Uganda declares Ebola outbreak after the Health Ministry confirmed a 24-year-old man showed symptoms and later died
Kiswahili: Uganda yatangaza mlipuko wa Ebola baada ya Wizara ya Afya kuthibitisha kuwa mwanaume wa miaka 24 alionyesha dalili na baadaye akafariki
Ekegusii: Uganda yatangasire egiateko kioborwaire bwa Ebola, ekero Ewizara y'Oborwaria yaenegeti omosacha bwemiaka 24 kabwate ebimanyererio bioborwaire obwo magega yaye agakwa.

English: Tiaty worst hit with 40% of residents affected. 2 people lost their lives last month due to Malaria. Govt distributing long-lasting treated mosquito nets
Kiswahili: Tiaty imeathiriwa zaidi na 40% ya wakazi walioathiriwa. Watu 2 walipoteza maisha yao mwezi uliopita kutokana na Malaria. Serikali yasambaza vyandarua vilivyotibiwa kwa muda mrefu
Ekegusii: Tiaty yanyorire egesusuro ekenene ase 40% ya abamenyi baye koambokerigwa. Abanto 2 basiririe amagima abo goetera oborwaire bw'Esosera. Eserekali nkoenana ere chineti chirwariri.

English: War on malaria gets a major boost. New drug Argesun deployed in Nyanza. Drug to help ICU patients, children with Malaria
Kiswahili: Vita dhidi ya malaria vyaongezeka sana. Dawa mpya ya Argesun yatumika Nyanza. Dawa ya kuwasaidia wagonjwa wa ICU, watoto wenye Malaria
Ekegusii: Esegi yokobua Malaria yamentekanire. Eriogo rigeni ria Argesun riatumekire Nyanza. Eriogo riogokonya abarwaire bare ICU, abana babwate Malaria.

English: Govt kicks of distribution of mosquito nets. Govt aims at distributing 15.3M treated nets
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua usambazaji wa vyandarua. Serikali inalenga kusambaza vyandarua milioni 15.3 vilivyotibiwa
Ekegusii: Eserekali yang'eire koenana chineti. Eserekali nigo erengete koenana chineti chirwariri 15.3M

English: Health officials deploy drones to combat malaria in Busia County
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa afya watuma ndege zisizo na rubani kupambana na malaria katika Kaunti ya Busia
Ekegusii: Aboobisa ba Afya/Oborwaria batumekire chindege erio korwania Malaria ase ekaunti ya Busia

English: Kenya among 12 African countries to get 18 million doses of malaria vaccine by 2025, WHO says priority will go to countries with the greatest need.
Kiswahili: Kenya miongoni mwa nchi 12 za Afrika kupata dozi milioni 18 za chanjo ya malaria ifikapo mwaka 2025, WHO inasema kipaumbele kitaelekezwa kwa nchi zenye uhitaji mkubwa zaidi.
