English: The National Police Service commends the continued cooperation of local residents in supporting this initiative to enhance peace, security, and stability in the region."We encourage the public to maintain their support by providing information at their nearest police station, or by calling 999, 911, or 112.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Kitaifa ya Polisi inapongeza ushirikiano unaoendelea wa wakazi wa eneo hilo katika kuunga mkono mpango huu wa kuimarisha amani, usalama, na utulivu katika eneo hilo. "Tunawahimiza umma kudumisha usaidizi wao kwa kutoa taarifa katika kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu nao, au kwa kupiga simu 999, 911, au 112."
Ekegusii: Ekeombe kia abasikari bobokoreri (NPS) bagokeire kogenderera kobwaterana nabanto ase ogosira omoroberio oyo erio goikerania omorembe, oborendi, na gotenena bokong'u ase orogongo. Nigo togosaba abanto babe noboremu nagosira emeremo eye goetera okorwa amangana gochia porisi ere ang'e, gose goetera goaka esimi 999, 911, gose 112.

English: We urge members of the public to provide any information that may assist in their arrest, the report stated in part.
Kiswahili: Tunawasihi wananchi kutoa taarifa yoyote ambayo inaweza kusaidia katika kukamatwa kwao, ripoti hiyo ilisema kwa sehemu.
Ekegusii: Twasabire abanto bonsi korwa manag'ana and onsi aranyare gokonya okobwatwa kwabo, buna eripoti ayio yatebete.

English: On the recruitment day, candidates must report to designated centres by 8am with original and copies of their academic certificates, ID cards, birth certificates, and, where applicable, NYS discharge certificates with at least a 'GOOD' conduct rating.
Kiswahili: Siku ya kuajiri, wagombea lazima waripoti katika vituo vilivyoteuliwa ifikapo saa 2 asubuhi wakiwa na cheti halisi na nakala za vyeti vyao vya kitaaluma, vitambulisho, vyeti vya kuzaliwa, na, inapohitajika, vyeti vya kufukuzwa vya NYS vyenye angalau ukadiriaji wa 'GOOD' wa mwenendo.

English: Security Matters Turning to security matters, the PS revealed that the government is set to launch a mobile app enabling citizens to report road-related incidents directly online.
Kiswahili: Masuala ya Usalama Akizungumzia masuala ya usalama, Katibu Mkuu huyo alifichua kwamba serikali iko tayari kuzindua programu ya simu inayowawezesha raia kuripoti matukio yanayohusiana na barabara moja kwa moja mtandaoni.
Ekegusii: Amangana oborendi aonchokire koba ayoborendi, Omoriki opamanenti (PS) nabisorete ng'a eserikari nere mbere gochakia egekoreri kieintaneti gokonya abanainchi komanyia igoro yemebasekano yechipara gochia eserikari.

English: "We are soon introducing a mobile app that allows citizens to report incidents, particularly road-related cases, directly online, he said.
Kiswahili: "Hivi karibuni tutaanzisha programu ya simu ambayo inaruhusu raia kuripoti matukio, hasa matukio yanayohusiana na barabara, moja kwa moja mtandaoni," alisema.
Ekegusii: "Iga bwango ngochaka tore egekoreri gieintaneti kogokonya abanainchi komanyia erikari amang'ana, mono kegima ayarengete emebasekano yechipara gochia ase bare gotaetera mono onde, buna atebete.

English: The Authority urges firms wishing to engage in parcel and courier services to apply for the requisite licenses from our offices in Nairobi, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nyeri and Mombasa and cautions members of the public to seek parcel and courier services from CA licensed providers only.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka inahimiza makampuni yanayotaka kujihusisha na huduma za vifurushi na usafirishaji wa mizigo kuomba leseni zinazohitajika kutoka ofisi zetu jijini Nairobi, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nyeri na Mombasa na inawaonya wananchi kutafuta huduma za vifurushi na usafirishaji wa mizigo kutoka kwa watoa huduma walio na leseni za CA pekee.
Ekegusii: Abatenereri bobobogoria emesigo basabirwe kwerika neserikari aaria Nairobi, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nyeri na Mombasa erio gwancherwa gokora emeremna gokurera abanto bonsi konyora ogokonywa kwogotoma emesigo yabo goetera baria bakoewa chisatifiketi echio (CA) boka.

English: Machogu urged the residents to ensure that they nurture the trees to maturity after planting and not to leave it as a responsibility of the Government.
Kiswahili: Machogu aliwasihi wakazi kuhakikisha kwamba wanaitunza miti hiyo hadi kukomaa baada ya kupanda na wasiiache kama jukumu la Serikali.
Ekegusii: Machogu nasabete abaibori koenekia ng'a barende emete basimekire goika ekine buya na tari gosimeka na gotigera eserikari erende.

English: The County Government of Kericho is advising all residents to remain on high alert due to the ongoing heavy rains being experienced across the county.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Kericho inawashauri wakazi wote kuendelea kuwa macho kutokana na mvua kubwa inayoendelea kunyesha kote kaunti.
Ekegusii: Teerikari yekaonti ya Kericho ngosemia ere abanto baye bonsi gotigara koba maiso igoro yembura enyinge eyio egendererete gotwa ime yekaonti engima.

English: The County Government appeals to all residents to exercise utmost caution, avoid crossing flooded roads or walking near swollen rivers, and to immediately report any emergencies or incidents to the nearest local administration office or through the County emergency hotline.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti inatoa wito kwa wakazi wote kuwa waangalifu sana, kuepuka kuvuka barabara zilizofurika au kutembea karibu na mito iliyofurika, na kuripoti mara moja dharura au matukio yoyote kwa ofisi ya utawala ya karibu au kupitia simu ya dharura ya Kaunti.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yekaonti nigo egosaba abanainchi bonsi ng'a babe maiso, tibatema goeta ase amache gose oroche rorew nomorindo bwamache, na komantia eserikari igoro ya mobasekano onde bwensi gochia amokoreri bweserikari ore ange nere gose goetera enamba ya morero yekaonti goetera eintaneti.

English: The County Government reiterates that the safety of residents remains its top priority and urges everyone to stay vigilant, follow official advisories, and support one another during this period of heavy rainfall.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti inarudia kwamba usalama wa wakazi unasalia kuwa kipaumbele chake cha juu na inawasihi kila mtu kuwa macho, kufuata ushauri rasmi, na kusaidiana wakati huu wa mvua kubwa.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yechokaonti yaenekeirie abanainchi nga nare maiso goikerania oborendi na gosaba kera oyomo koba maiso, kobwatia obosemia, na gokonyana chingaki echi chiembura enyinge.

English: To ensure public safety during the renovation, the County Government has issued a clear directive: Members of the public have been directed to stay at least 30 metres away from the hospital site.
Kiswahili: Ili kuhakikisha usalama wa umma wakati wa ukarabati, Serikali ya Kaunti imetoa agizo wazi: Wananchi wameagizwa kukaa angalau mita 30 kutoka eneo la hospitali.
Ekegusii: Erio goikerania oborendi obuya chingaki chiokoagacha keboyia chinyomba , eserikari yekaonti yarure omoroberio omoronge: Abanto baboriigwe koba are nase ayio yamaagacho goika oboare bwachifuti 100 korwa ase amaagacho agokorerwa yoboagachi bwenyagitari.

English: Youth engagement took centre stage in Kisumu County this week as leaders threw down the gauntlet, urging young residents to swap spectator seats for the architect's table in governance.
Kiswahili: Ushiriki wa vijana ulichukua nafasi muhimu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu wiki hii huku viongozi wakipuuza vikwazo, wakiwahimiza wakazi vijana kubadilishana viti vya watazamaji na meza ya mbunifu katika utawala.
Ekegusii: Okobwaterana nabasae aaria ekaonti ya Kisumu ewiki eye nigo kwabete kwomonguso ase abant abange ekero abarai barwete ogosaba nga abasae babogorie egetambokero kioborendi. Gosegeta abasae batige koba magega na abarigereria korende korende kobwaterana korora ng'a ebirengererio biabo biasoire ase emeroberio yobogamb gose oborai.

English: The event, held at Gilgil Stadium, was streamed live on KDF platforms to promote transparency and educate the public on the recruitment process.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo, iliyofanyika katika Uwanja wa Gilgil, ilirushwa moja kwa moja kwenye majukwaa ya KDF ili kukuza uwazi na kuelimisha umma kuhusu mchakato wa kuajiri.

Ekegusii: ElectionAccess.org nigo geteneneire nekeombe giense igoro yomoroberio nobokoreri bwobochori (IFES), ekio kere ekeombe getari gieserikari gose giokorosia efaita kieruete gokongia dimokirasia ase obochori ase ogosira oborenge bwabaaki chikura korora nga mbare neribaga gokora obochori botari bwokorekanu

English: GNDEM stands in solidarity with I Watch and all nonpartisan citizen election observers who face threats against their right to observe elections and defend the right of citizens to exercise their vote.
Kiswahili: GNDEM inasimama kwa mshikamano na I Watch na waangalizi wote wa uchaguzi wa raia wasioegemea upande wowote ambao wanakabiliwa na vitisho dhidi ya haki yao ya kuangalia uchaguzi na kutetea haki ya raia ya kutumia kura yao.
Ekegusii: GNDEM neteneine gokongu na I Watch nabanainchi bonsi baria batari koengera gochia aa gose aaria korigereria buna chikura chigoakwa abwo bare ase okogoswa igor yoboronge bwabo bwookomongera buna chikura chigoakwa na koegerera abanainchi goaka chikura chiabo buya.

English: Everyone has the right to participate in government and public affairs, including by seeking to be elected and to vote in genuinely democratic elections.
Kiswahili: Kila mtu ana haki ya kushiriki katika masuala ya serikali na umma, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutafuta kuchaguliwa na kupiga kura katika chaguzi za kidemokrasia za kweli.
Ekegusii: Kera omonto nare neribaga riokomanya na koboria buna eserikari egokora emeremo, amo na gochorwa gose goaka ekura ase enchera yekeene.

English: Nonpartisan (politically impartial and independent) election monitoring by citizens is an extension of the rights to genuine elections, to participate in public affairs, to associate and to seek, receive and impart information in the electoral context.
Kiswahili: Ufuatiliaji wa uchaguzi usioegemea upande wowote (usioegemea upande wowote kisiasa na huru) unaofanywa na raia ni mwendelezo wa haki za uchaguzi halisi, kushiriki katika masuala ya umma, kujumuika na kutafuta, kupokea na kutoa taarifa katika muktadha wa uchaguzi.
Ekegusii: Goetaengera (omonto oteneine gesiasa na ase okeene) okorigereria buna chikura chiogoakwa nigo ebwatekaine nogoikerania nga kera omonto nare neribaga goteba eki arengete goetera goacka chikura, nechikura goakwa ase oboene, giosangerekana na korigia, konyora na komanyia abnde amang'ana igoro yechikura.

English: At the same time, elections allow citizens to aggregate their interests to demand that those seeking office address issues related to economic, social and cultural well being, as well as peace and security.
Kiswahili: Wakati huo huo, uchaguzi huwaruhusu raia kuunganisha maslahi yao ili kuwataka wale wanaotafuta ofisi kushughulikia masuala yanayohusiana na ustawi wa kiuchumi, kijamii na kitamaduni, pamoja na amani na usalama.
Ekegusii: Amo nayio, chikura nigo chifokonya abaaki chikura kobeka amo abirengereri nokogania kwabo amo na koboria ng'a baria bakorigia chikura babogoriew ase oborito aamang'ana obogoko bwenyoro biabo, amagenderero nakomenya buya, naboigo omorembe noborendi.

English: The rights of citizens to vote and to be elected at periodic, genuine democratic elections are internationally recognized human rights.
Kiswahili: Haki za raia kupiga kura na kuchaguliwa katika chaguzi za kidemokrasia za mara kwa mara na za kweli ni haki za binadamu zinazotambuliwa kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Oboronge bwabanainch goaka chikura na korigia chikura gochorwa ase chingaki gete, gobochori bwaboronge nigo bokobeka motwe gose bogosika oboronge bwekemwanyabanto.

English: Read on WRA warns land grabbers targeting protected dunes KNA2 October 7, 2025 Counties , Environment , Lamu 0 Water Resources Authority (WRA) has issued a directive to individuals illegally occupying and subdividing gazzetted wetlands and sand dunes in Lamu County, ordering cease such activities or face prosecution.

English: The result, our Anti-Corruption Enforcement Tracker helps campaigners build an evidence base for reform of anti-corruption enforcement, provides journalists and members of the public with accessible and clear statistics, and encourages the government to collect and publish its data in more accessible and accurate ways.

Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene getenerete oboronge bwamwanyabanto (KNCHR) mbangete ebikoru bwomonene bwabasikari kogenda mamincha namachiko yobokoreri bwekeombe getenerete obokoreri bwabasikari, komokurera ng'a ebikoru biaye nigo bire mamincha nobomongeria.

English: A senior police official stepped aside during a custody death probe to avoid conflicts in investigations handled by independent authorities.
Ekegusii: Chingaki omosikari omonene atenete ensemo korwa ribaga riobotuki ekero omonto akwerete eseri ime erio gotasoananera obotuki buna bwaregokorwa nebiombe biogwetenerera.

English: Press coverage summarized IPOA oversight statistics showing modest improvements and ongoing gaps in complaint handling and convictions.
Ekegusii: Amanagana amagaseti narwete ase obweng'e igoro buna engencho ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari IPOA kegendererete gokora emeremo buya mono kegima ase oboremu borengete buna okwemuranganania gokoborigwa na gokorerwa emeremo.

English: Families of a shooting victim demanded legal action; IPOA confirmed active investigation and emphasized supervisory accountability.
Ekegusii: Amamwabo baria barasetie amasasi nabasikari mbaboretie ng'a ebotambokero biamachiko bibogorigwe as abasikari; ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) nkiaenegetie obotuki obuya na koboria nga abateneneri babasikari babogorie amamocho ayio.

English: Judicial leadership endorsed IPOA’s mandate and pledged support for stronger cooperation between the judiciary and the oversight body.
Ekegusii: Abatenereri bokogamba ebina mbaete okoboko ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) buna kegokora emeremo na koenekia kobasira ase okobwaterana gti yechikoti nebiombe biria bikomongera obokoreri bwabo.

English: A review detailed IPOA’s achievements, challenges, and strategic direction and outlined next steps in police accountability reform.
Ekegusii: Okorigereria keboyia ngwatebe geikaranu buna ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) giakorire buya, emechamndo ereo, amo nemeroberio yabeene yar koorokia ebitambokero bia motwe biogoikerania abasikari gotenera ebikotu biegasi yabo.

English: The Interior Ministry and IPOA launched a comprehensive police reform framework emphasizing oversight and streamlined complaint mechanisms.
Ekegusii: Ewizara yoborendi bwa ime na ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) mbaansete omoroberio omonene bwokoreta oboonchoreria ase obokoreri bwa porisi na kobeka chinguri obomongeri nenchera engiya yokomanyia okwemurungania kwa abanto.

English: A legal ruling confirmed IPOA’s exclusive authority to investigate police misconduct and rejected attempts to limit its jurisdiction.
Ekegusii: Okonacha gwekoti nkwaete ekeombe keria gietenererete kia abasikari (IPOA) chinguru chiogotuka buna abasikari bagokora bobe na kwanga ogosaba ng'a chinguru chiabo chikeanigwe.

English: IPOA announced a prosecution outcome in a Nyeri manslaughter case involving a police officer, underscoring accountability progress.
Ekegusii: Ekoti ekanacha ekina ng'a ekeombe keria getenenerete korigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo (IPOA) nkere nokobua koringoria amamocho abasikari bakora igo ekanga ogosaba ng'a chinguru chiabo chikeanigwe.

English: IPOA referred multiple misconduct cases to the DPP for legal action, aiming to convert oversight into convictions.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gietenerete korigereria buna abasikari bagokora emeremo yabo (IPOA) nkiaorogetie maiso marore buna ekina kiagambetwe bobe aaria Mombasa, nagosaba ng’a obomaiso marore amo enchera yokorwa egesusuro

English: An analysis assessed police tactics used during mass demonstrations, focusing on proportionality, arrests, and rights-based policing.
Ekegusii: Amasomo abeene igoro yabasikari nkworokia kore buna abasikari bakoererania ekerogo korobererekana, bagotumia chinguru koreng’ana nobonge bwabanto, nagoetera enchera yekemwanyabanto.

English: A police partnership initiative trained young women in self-defense and educated participants on rights and complaint channels.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio bwokobwaterana nabasikari mbwegeretie abangina abasae buna baranyare kwerende korwa emechando na gosomia omosangerekano igoro yoboronge bwabo amo nenchera yokorwa okwemuranganania.

English: Posters distributed nationwide explained suspects’ rights, legal search limits, and how to file complaints with oversight bodies.
Ekegusii: Ebinto bwabwate amariko are komanyia oboronge bwomokagerwa, ekerngo giokomotababa, na buna oranyare gosoera abasikari gochia ase baria bakomongera buna abasikari bagokora emeremo.

English: Community artists created a public mural in Naivasha promoting themes of oversight, justice, and citizen–police partnership.
Ekegusii: Abanyangero borogongo mabkorete emeremo amo yogwata chibicha chinene nagochinati chinyasi Naivasha gosegeta emeremo yamongeria, ekeene, nokobwaterana kwabanainchi nabasikari.

English: Government launched a campaign promoting cyber hygiene and awareness of the National Cybersecurity Strategy.
Ekegusii: Eserekekari yachagete omoroberio bwokomanyia abanto igoro yogotumia buya eintaneti na korenda ng'a tesoa se abako amabe buna omoroberio omonene bweserikari igoro yeintaneti.

English: Interior Ministry announced increased multi‑agency patrols during the festive season to deter crime.
Ekegusii: Eministiri ya yoborendi bwa ime goetera abitengo ao ao yamentete ogoonchokanana korenda obokebago chingaki chia amatuko emeyega ao ao gotanga obokebago.

English: Interior CS briefed Senate on national security readiness and coordinated agency efforts.
Ekegusii: Omominisita bwoborendi bwa ine namanyetie ekegambero gieseneti buna yeariganetie ase oborendi bwense na okobwaterana nebitengo ao ao.

English: Public advised not to circulate graphic images after the DusitD2 attack to protect victims’ dignity.
Ekegusii: Abanainchi basabirwe tibasiarera chibicha chiokwoboi buna DusitD2 yaagetwe ebomu erio korenda amasikani ya baria baagetwe nepomu.

English: Government launched an initiative to combat illegal firearms trafficking with education and surveillance.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yachagete omoroberio bwogokora ebiasara biechibunduki goetra chisemi na education and buna chikoereranigwa.

English: Government launched a nationwide campaign to raise awareness on the dangers of illegal arms trafficking through community outreach and media.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yachakire omoroberio omonene komanyia abanto goetera mesangerekano ao ao yebinyoro igoro yobobe bwebiasara biechibunduki chire ase amaboko amabe.

English: Opposition leaders demanded the president’s resignation after he appeared to endorse shoot-on-sight rhetoric during protests.
Ekegusii: Abarai bopinsani mbaimokererete igoro koboria omorai bwense erusie emeremo ekero aitabete ng'a abanto bagosangerekana baraswe amagogoro abwo abwo buna enchera yokobeka asikari chinguri chiogogokorera bobe baria bakorobererekana.

English: Times of India highlighted over 300 injuries during youth-led protests, with Gen Z activists criticizing police rigidity and government suppression.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe giokomanyia amangana kia Times of India nkiarogetie igoro yabanto goetania 300 ekero giokorobererekana kwabasae, abwo abaegereri ba Gen Z abwo bwaatorete amamocho abasikari neserikari ase okwanga goonchoreria na kobwatia amachiko erio okomiga baria baroche nga esikari mbobe ere.

English: The Guardian covered the arrest of a constable linked to a political blogger’s death in custody, seen as a rare step toward accountability.
Ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana ba The Guardian mbarigete igoro yokobwatwa kwomosikari oyio otumegete gesiasa na komobwata kwomoriki amangana bwetenenerete oyio okerete eseri ya polisi buna enchera eyemo ekworokia buna abasikari babweneret goajibika.

English: Washington Post highlighted unresolved disappearances tied to protest crackdowns, intensifying calls for investigative transparency.
Ekegusii: Abarai ba Washington Post mbaboretie igoro yabanto basira gose gokenganigwa ase engencho yokomiga baria bokorobererekana, eye yarangeirie okoboria ng'a obotuki bobe maiso marore.

English: Reuters reported police firing on protesters blocking roads on Saba Saba Day, causing injuries as authorities enforced lockdown measures.
Ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana ba Reuters mbarigetw ng'a abasikari korasa abarorobererekani, gosieka chipara ekero gia Saba Saba Day, koumisa abanto ekiagera absrai batebete ebe bo.

English: Al Jazeera reported at least eleven protesters killed during Saba Saba Day demonstrations, citing police use of live ammunition.
Ekegusii: Abariki amang'ana na Al Jazeera mbarigete ng'a goika ange abanto 11 barenge ase okorobererekana mbaitetwe ekero kierituko ria Saba Saba, na fgoteba ng'a abasikari mbarasete amasasi.

English: WSWS detailed mass mobilizations following a blogger’s custodial death, marked by tear gas, water cannons, arrests, and teacher solidarity strikes.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekene giense getenenerete oboitoni bwegesiasa, na buna omoganda omonene ogotenenerwa goetera obokoreri beintaneti (WSWS) nkiarigete ase oboikeranu buna abanto barangereretani ekero omoriki amangana bwogwetenenera akwete ase amabko abasikari, abatekaine nokorasa ebinto bierioko, amache abwate easidi, okobwatwa, na abarimi buna bagirete egasi ase kwogokwa kwoyomwabo.

English: Reuters captured escalating violence in Nairobi protests, including burning vehicles amid outrage over a blogger’s death in custody.
Ekegusii: Abariki amangana ba Reuters mbabwatete buna eburaburu yarenge aaria Nairobi, na gosamba chirori ase obororo bwogokwa kwomoriki amangana bwogwetenenera ase eseri ya porisi.

English: Reuters reported charges against activist Boniface Mwangi for alleged possession of tear gas and ammunition, raising concerns over politicized enforcement.
Ekegusii: Abariki amangana ba Reuters mbamanyetie igoro mamamocho nogosoerwa kwomoegereri Boniface Mwangi nga nabwate ebinto biria bigwateka biarusia erioki nechimbunde mamincha nerichiko, eri riaretire obwoba buna siasa yatumekire kobuna amachiko.

English: AP News covered Mwangi’s release on bail and rights groups’ criticism of terrorism charge misuse during protests.
Ekegusii: Managana amayia yabasikari boborai (AP) nyarigete igoo yokobwatokwa kwa Mwangi ase ogotenenerwa nebiombe biokoegerera ebio biangete okobekererwa kwobosaria bwobokegago bwokoruta chipomu ekero bakorobererekana.

English: Human Rights Watch released video analyses showing police use of live rounds, teargas, arbitrary arrests, and command-authorized force.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria gekomongera oboronge bwa mwanyabanto nkiarwete esinema ekworokia buna abasikari bare korasa chimbunde, koruta ebinto biria bikorusia erioki, kobwata abanto bosaigo, negetengo kiabasikari inse yamachiko korwa abanene babo korasa chimbunde.

English: Social media artists released protest-themed music amplifying survivors’ stories and urging public demand for police reform.
Ekegusii: Ebiombo biokomanyia amang'ana goetera chingero mbasogetie chingero chikorwa omogano bwa baria barasetwe nabasikari gosegeta abanainchi gosaba oboonchoreria ase amachiko abasikari.

English: A trauma-support hotline staffed by psychologists was launched to assist survivors and witnesses of protest violence.
Ekegusii: Egetuo kiogokonya abachandeku bebirengererio kiabetwe abanyagitari ba bosa goetra enamba yesimi nkiaansetwe lgokonya abwo nabasaiti babo.

English: Academic forums examined youth trauma, state violence, and pathways to justice arising from protest repression.
Ekegusii: Okoumerana kwabasomi korigia ekerengo abasae baumiete kebirengererio nobongo, buna obogambi bogotumua chinguru koumisa abanainchi, amo nenchira chireo korigia obokonyi bwekemachiko ase okomiga abakorobererekana.

English: Editorial commentary advocated reforms to the Public Order Act to safeguard peaceful assembly and curb excessive force.
Ekegusii: Amanga ya abange buna barwete ebirengererio biabo gosegeta oboonchoreria ase richiko ritenenerete buna abanto baukoumerana ase obonge na korobererekana erio korenda ogocha amo nokorobererekana kwomorembe igo gotanga abasikari gotumia chinguru chinyinge.

English: Interior CS announced reinforced security deployments and intelligence operations to address terrorism threats along Kenya’s borders.
Ekegusii: Omominisita bwoborendi bwa ime namanyetie igoro yokomentwa kwe'namba yabasikari nobotuki erio koba maiso korwa obokebago bwogoaka chipomu ase chimbebe chia Kenya.

English: Government launched the Jasiri Fund to support reintegration of former extremists through psychosocial care and business training.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yaansete ekegancha gia Jasiri Fund gosire okoirana kwa baria konye basiriigwe ebirengererio gochia obokebago bwogoaka chipomu goetera obosemia, nobobobwenia bwebirengererio nobongo amo nechisemi chioboonchoreria.

English: Kenya and the U.S. signed a partnership to strengthen border surveillance, intelligence sharing, and law-enforcement training.
Ekegusii: Kenya amo neserikari ya America baigwanire kobwaterana erio gokong'ia obomongeri bwechinsinyo chiato, koererania obutuki, na amasomo buna amachiko agokora emeremo.

English: NCTC partnered with NGOs to educate youth on digital extremist threats and strategies to resist online radicalization.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiabwatanete NGOs gosomia abasae igoro gosarigwa ebirengererio goetera chinchera chiegedichitari amo nechira kwanga ogosarigwa ebirengererio goetera eintaneti and.

English: NCTC unveiled the “Jasiri Observatory” public portal to help communities identify and counter extremist ideologies.
Ekegusii: keombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngiaasioria omoroberio “Jasiri Observatory” eyio ere eintaneti yabainchi gokonya ebinyoro komanya na gotanga amasomo yogosaria abanto ebirengererio.

English: County-level forums were convened nationwide to review and update Kenya’s National Strategy to Prevent and Counter Violent Extremism.
Ekegusii: Emesangerekano yechkaonti yakoretwe kenya engima korigereria keboyia erio gokongia oborendi ase ogotanga uobokebago bwogotumia chinguru.

English: Government launched a revised national CVE strategy emphasizing technology integration and youth-focused interventions.
Ekegusii: Eserikari yarure omoroberio omoyia bwense na omoikeranu gotanga na korwania obokebago bwogotumia chinguru (CVE) ogosegeta kobwatania etikinorochi amo nemeroberio erengete abasae.

English: NCTC conducted training for county officials on raising public awareness and preventing radicalization.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngiasometie abarai bechikaonti buna baramanyie abanto babo buna baranyare gotanga amasomo ogsaria abanto ebirengererio.

English: A multi-agency program enhanced ATPU officers’ capacity in ideological awareness and counterterror response.
Ekegusii: Oboamo bweitengo ao ao bieserikari mbwakongetie chinuru chiekeombe keria kiabasikari gekorwania gotanga obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (ATPU) korora na komanya buna kogosaria ebirengererio nokomenya amo.

English: NCTC and OAB (IOM-Japan) coordinated a community policing initiative in Lamu to strengthen early-warning and reporting systems.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) na ofisi yomonene bwamachiko (OAB) goetera (IOM-Japan) bakabwaterania ase omoroberio bwoborendi bwebinyoro aaria Lamu gokongia komanya bwango na korwa eripoti.

English: Mining Department and NCTC jointly trained stakeholders on safe handling of commercial explosives to mitigate terror risks.
Ekegusii: Eminisiti yokorema  amadini na keombe keria getenenerete gotanga na korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ase oboama baegeirie abasangi buna babwenerete kogacha, kobirenda kobibogoria na kobitumia buna enchera eyemo yogotanga ogosaganwa korwa isiko.

English: NCTC facilitated training in Kakamega to help security personnel counter youth radicalization and emerging extremist tactics.
Ekegusii: NCTC facilitated training in Kakamega to help security personnel counter youth radicalization and emerging extremist tactics.

English: NCTC launched a sub-county engagement forum in Nyeri to enhance resilience, public reporting, and localized action plans.
Ekegusii: NCTC launched a sub-county engagement forum in Nyeri to enhance resilience, public reporting, and localized action plans.

English: NCTC highlighted socio-economic vulnerabilities—poverty and marginalization—as drivers of youth susceptibility to extremist recruitment.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiarogetie buna obogengeru bwobogoko nabanto - obotaka nogochaya buna ebinto bigoseta abase gosoa kwenyora abasqangi ase ogosoa ase ebiombe biria bigosaria amongo abo goitaba obokebago.

English: NCTC led a national dialogue addressing youth vulnerabilities exploited by extremist groups and promoting multi-stakeholder resilience.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiaraete chinkwana chiense gokwanera buna obogongeru bwabasae bogotumeka nabibago biria bigosaria amongo abo na gosegeta okobwaterana korwa chinsemo ao ao.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre emphasized patriotism and integration of national strategy priorities into county forums to advance prevention efforts.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiabegete chinguru ringana riobwegenwa bwense yaito na kobwatania emeroberio yense gochia ase ebikaranso biechikaonti erio gokong'ia gotanga obokebago integration of national strategy priorities into county.

English: United Nations facilitated regional training in Nairobi to strengthen gender responsive approaches in counter terrorism and preventing violent extremism.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe ekenene giense (UN) nkiaegeretie abarai bechingongo chia Nairobi erio gokwanera obokongu abanto bechingencho ao ao babwate ario gosegeta oboreng'ananu buna enchera eyemo yogotanga obokebago nogosarigwa ebirengererio.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre rolled out a community based strategy to deter extremism and urged awareness of technology related risks.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngiansete omoroberio bwebinyoro gotanga ogosarigwa ebirengererio na gosaba okomanyigwa igoro yobwoba bwegetekinorochia.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre launched the Jasiri resilience portal to help communities identify extremist ideologies and promote counter narratives online.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) yaansete eintaneti ya Jasiri resilience portal gokonya abanainchi komanya amasomo agosari ebirengererio na gosegeta chinkwana chiogotanga gosarigwa ebirengererion goetera eintaneti.

English: Ongoing training in Kakamega supports security personnel in staying ahead of evolving violent extremism tactics affecting youth.
Ekegusii: Okwegererigwa gwakogenderera aari Kakamega gwakonyire abarendi borendi gotigara maiso igoro yechiburaburu chiogosaria abasae ebirengererio chiakegeire koba.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre organized a five day workshop to contextualize a national manual on gender mainstreaming in counter terrorism.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiaroberetie ogasanga amo kwegera komanya egetabu gekworokia buna okobwaterana na banto bechingencho ao ao nobomanyi bwabo erakonye korwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre helped develop social media monitoring systems to detect hate speech and radical ideologies while protecting freedom of expression.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngiakonyete korosia chinchera abariki amangana baranyare komongera, koigwa na komanya amangana, chinkwana gose ebiorokererio biokogosereria, gochegia, gose gosegeta ogochaya abande egekogera eki bare, na chisemi chiogosaria ebirengererio ase okwebisa ime yerichiko riobosibore bwogokwana.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre invited public contributions for artificial intelligence solutions to counter online radicalization and self recruitment.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) nkiaariganetie ebirengererio korwa abanainchi korigia amachibu igoro yechisemi chia pandia buna enchera eyemo yokorwania obokebago bwogosaria ebirengererio goetra eintaneti na na kwerika barabwo abanyene gochia ase obosaria obwo.

English: National rollout of the prison based CVE awareness program reached over thirty thousand officers through national and international partnerships.
Ekegusii: Omoroberio omonene bwabasikari bechera noansete komanyia buna chinchera chiogotanga obokebago bwogosaria ebirengererio oyio oikerete goetania abaofisa chilifu 30,000 goetera okobwaterana Kenya ase okobwaterana nense engima.

English: County level action plan launched in Baringo to address extremist recruitment in schools and religious institutions through community engagement.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio yechikaonti gokwanera igoro yogosarigwa amongo nagosoigwa obokebago ase chisukuru gose chikanisa bemesikiti noansetwe aaria Baringo goetera chinkwana nabanyabinyoro.

English: United Nations launched a youth engagement and empowerment program to train young leaders on policy, advocacy, and preventing violent extremism.
Ekegusii: Onomo bwechinse (UN) mbwachagete omoroberio bwogokwanerana nabasae na kobabeka chinguru ase okwegeria abarai ba abasae igiro yamachiko, amasomo igor yebinto bibweneretye goonchoreria, na gotanga ogosarigwa obongo koba ekebago.

English: Over thirty thousand Kenya Prison Service staff received training on detecting and mitigating violent extremism within correctional facilities.
Ekegusii: Goetania abasikari 30,000 bechera mbanyorete amasomo buna bakiomanya na gotanga ogosarigwa obongo koba ekebago giokoruta chipomu ime ase chichera.

English: Regional training of trainers workshop in Nairobi promoted gender sensitive counter terrorism policies across East Africa.
Ekegusii: Okwegerigwa kwa abarai bechingongo buan abegeria abande aaria Nairobi nosegetete engencho yokorenta amo abanto bechingencho chionsi buna enchera eyemo yokorwania gotanga koruta chipomu orgongo rwa Afrika ya Mocha engima (East Africa).

English: Learning event in coastal counties brought religious leaders and civil society together to strengthen local prevention efforts.
Ekegusii: Emesangerekano yogosoma aaria chikaonti chire mbarabare nechinyancha marete amo abarai bechidini amo nebiombe biria bitari bieserikari (NGOs) goikerania okobwaterana nabarai korwa inse.

English: National Counter Terrorism Centre promotes the See Something Say Something campaign encouraging prompt reporting of suspicious activity.
Ekegusii: Ekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) ngoseta kere ng'a kore omoroberio okorokwa "rora egento - teba gente gete" ogosegeta abanto komanyia abarai bwango amangana gose ebikoru biechitang'utang'u.

English: Interior Cabinet Secretary reaffirms commitment to prosecuting acts that qualify as terrorism including destruction of property and threats to public services.
Ekegusii: Omominisita bwoborendi bwa ime oenekirie okwerwa gweserikari gosera na kogambia ebikorwa bigosegeta obokebago amo nogari chinibo na korenta obwoba ase obokoreri bwa'banto.

English: The National Counter Terrorism Centre and Operation Amani Boni conducted community workshops in Lamu County that focused on awareness, intelligence sharing, and resilience building.
Ekegusii: Emeroberio yekeombe keria ekenene gekorwania obokebago bwokoruta chipomu (NCTC) orogetwe "Amani Boni" nokorete emesangererekano aaria ekaonti ya Lamu yamoregete omokanyia abanto, koererania amang'ana obotuki, na kobakong'ia.

English: Kenya, Indonesia, and the Netherlands held a joint knowledge sharing program to improve strategies for preventing and countering violent extremism.
Ekegusii: Kenya, Indonesia, amo na Netherlands mbabete nogocha amo koererania oboinga'ini nechisemi gokong'ia emeroberio gotanga na korwania obokebago bwogosaria obongo.

English: The ODPP issued guidance explaining Kenya’s legal definition of terrorism under the Prevention of Terrorism Act.
Ekegusii: Omorai omonene bwobosoi ebina (ODPP) narwete oborai bware bogeteba igoro ya Kenya buna okomanya kwabo igoro yobokebago bwokoruta chipomu inse yerichiko riogotanga obokebago.

English: The Interior Minister restated the zero tolerance stance toward acts classified as terrorism and emphasized justice and public protection.
